title: A pen-based Japanese character input system for the blind person
authors: Ezaki, N. and Hikichi, T. and Kiyota, K. and Yamamoto, S.
venue: Proceedings 15th International Conference on Pattern Recognition. ICPR-2000
summary_en: Tablet handwriting is recognized as Japanese text; spoken candidates support selection, rewriting and editing.
summary_zh: 平板手写识别生成日文文字，通过语音播报候选，支持选择、重写与编辑。
summary_ja: タブレットの手書きを日本語として認識し、音声候補で選択・書き直し・編集を支援する。
summary_ko: 태블릿 필기를 일본어로 인식하고 음성 후보로 선택, 다시 쓰기, 편집을 지원한다.

title: Digital library access for chinese visually impaired
authors: Luk, Robert and Yeung, Daniel and Lu, Qin and Leung, Eric and Li, S. Y. and Leung, Fred
venue: Proceedings of the fifth ACM conference on Digital libraries
summary_en: Six-key Braille codes become Chinese search queries, with character, word-prefix and sentence input.
summary_zh: 六键盲文编码转换为中文检索式，支持单字、词前缀和句子输入。
summary_ja: 6キーの点字符号を中国語検索式に変換し、文字・語頭・文の入力に対応する。
summary_ko: 6키 점자 코드를 중국어 검색어로 변환하며 글자, 단어 접두부, 문장 입력을 지원한다.

title: Design and implementation of a chorded on-screen keyboard for people with physical impairments
authors: Lin, Yun-Lung and Chen, Ming-Chung and Yeh, Yao-Ming and Tzeng, Wen-Jeng and Yeh, Chih-Ching
venue: Computers Helping People with Special Needs
summary_en: A chorded on-screen keyboard supports Chinese phonetic and shape-code layouts; the reported copy-typing task uses English.
summary_zh: 和弦式屏幕键盘支持中文注音及形码布局；文中报告的抄录任务使用英文。
summary_ja: コード式画面キーボードは中国語の表音・字形配列を備えるが、報告された転記課題は英語である。
summary_ko: 화음식 화면 키보드는 중국어 표음·형태 배열을 지원하지만 보고된 베껴 쓰기 과제는 영어이다.

title: Designing a scanning on-screen keyboard for people with severe motor disabilities
authors: Lin, Yun-Lung and Wu, Ting-Fang and Chen, Ming-Chung and Yeh, Yao-Ming and Wang, Hwa-Pey
venue: Computers Helping People with Special Needs
summary_en: A scanning keyboard includes two Chinese layouts. The language used in the experimental article is not clearly specified.
summary_zh: 扫描式键盘包含两种中文布局，但实验所用文章的语言未明确说明。
summary_ja: 走査式キーボードは中国語配列を2種類備える。実験文章の言語は明記されていない。
summary_ko: 스캐닝 키보드는 중국어 배열 두 가지를 갖추지만 실험 문서의 언어는 명확하지 않다.

title: A fast text-based communication system for handicapped aphasiacs
authors: Fu, Yu-Fen and Ho, Cheng-Seen
venue: 2009 Fifth International Conference on Intelligent Information Hiding and Multimedia Signal Processing
summary_en: Coordinate gestures select Zhuyin symbols, tones and Chinese candidates; entered text can be spoken aloud.
summary_zh: 坐标手势用于选择注音符号、声调和汉字候选，输入的文字可通过语音朗读。
summary_ja: 座標ジェスチャーで注音・声調・漢字候補を選択し、入力文を音声で読み上げる。
summary_ko: 좌표 제스처로 주음, 성조, 한자 후보를 선택하며 입력 문장을 음성으로 읽을 수 있다.

title: R&D of the Japanese Input Method using an eye-controlled communication device for users with disabilities and evaluation with NIRS
authors: Kotani, Shinji and Watanabe, Hiromi and Komasaki, Tetsu and Ohgi, Kazuhiro and Yamamoto, Yoshihiko
venue: 2010 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man and Cybernetics
summary_en: Gaze operates three Japanese input layouts for kana and Kanji. NIRS measures responses during evaluation rather than controlling input.
summary_zh: 眼动操控三种日文输入布局，输入假名和汉字；近红外测量用于评估，并非输入控制通道。
summary_ja: 視線で3種類の日本語配列を操作する。NIRSは評価測定であり入力信号ではない。
summary_ko: 시선으로 세 가지 일본어 배열을 조작한다. NIRS는 평가 측정이며 입력 신호가 아니다.

title: An assistive communication brain-computer interface for Chinese text input
authors: Minett, James W. and Peng, Gang and Zhou, Lin and Zheng, Hong-Ying and Wang, William S.-Y.
venue: 2010 4th International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedical Engineering
summary_en: A brain interface selects traditional Chinese characters, radicals and strokes. Complete large-vocabulary entry is proposed rather than demonstrated.
summary_zh: 脑机界面选择繁体汉字、部件和笔画；完整的大字库输入是提出的目标，尚未实际展示。
summary_ja: 脳インタフェースで繁体字・部品・筆画を選択する。大語彙の完全な入力は構想段階である。
summary_ko: 뇌 인터페이스로 번체자, 부품, 획을 선택한다. 대규모 어휘의 완전한 입력은 제안 단계이다.

title: Accurate Braille-Chinese translation towards efficient Chinese input method for blind people
authors: Wang, Chao and Wang, Xiangdong and Qian, Yueliang and Lin, Shouxun
venue: 5th International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Applications
summary_en: Mandarin Braille paragraphs are translated into simplified Chinese for a proposed input method for blind users.
summary_zh: 将汉语盲文段落转换为简体中文，服务于面向盲人的输入法。
summary_ja: 中国語点字の段落を簡体字に変換し、視覚障害者向け入力法への応用を目指す。
summary_ko: 중국어 점자 문단을 간체자로 변환하여 시각장애인용 입력기에 활용한다.

title: Proficiency evaluation of three Japanese Input Methods using an eye-controlled communication device for users with disabilities
authors: Kotani, Shinji and Watanabe, Hiromi and Komasaki, Tetsu and Tanzawa, Tsutomu and Ohgi, Kazuhiro and Kenmotsu, Takahide
venue: 2011 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
summary_en: Eye-controlled Japanese input is evaluated with mixed kana–Kanji passages; clinical accounts also describe names and lyrics.
summary_zh: 通过含假名与汉字的段落评估眼控日文输入，临床使用记录还涉及姓名和歌词。
summary_ja: 仮名漢字混じり文で視線入力を評価する。臨床利用の記録には名前や歌詞も含まれる。
summary_ko: 가나·한자 혼합 문장으로 시선 입력을 평가하며 임상 사용 기록에는 이름과 가사도 포함된다.

title: Text entry competency for students with learning disabilities in grade 5 to 6
authors: Wu, Ting-Fang and Chen, Ming-Chung
venue: Computers Helping People with Special Needs
summary_en: Students with learning disabilities enter traditional Chinese by assembling Zhuyin phonetic symbols.
summary_zh: 有学习障碍的学生通过组合注音符号输入繁体中文。
summary_ja: 学習障害のある児童が注音記号を組み合わせて繁体字を入力する。
summary_ko: 학습장애가 있는 학생이 주음 기호를 조합하여 번체자를 입력한다.

title: Usability evaluation of text input methods for smartphone among the elderly
authors: Hamano, Yuichiro and Nishiuchi, Nobuyuki
venue: 2013 International Conference on Biometrics and Kansei Engineering
summary_en: Older adults use smartphone methods for Japanese kana or English entry; Kanji conversion is not evaluated.
summary_zh: 老年用户使用智能手机输入日文假名或英文，研究未评估汉字转换。
summary_ja: 高齢者によるスマートフォンの仮名・英語入力を評価する。漢字変換は評価していない。
summary_ko: 고령자의 스마트폰 가나·영어 입력을 평가하며 한자 변환은 평가하지 않는다.

title: Usage situation changes of touchscreen computers in Japanese visually impaired people: Questionnaire surveys in 2011-2013
authors: Miura, Takahiro and Sakajiri, Masatsugu and Matsuzaka, Haruo and Eljailani, Murtada and Kudo, Kazuki and Kitamura, Naoya and Onishi, Junji and Ono, Tsukasa
venue: Computers Helping People with Special Needs
summary_en: Questionnaires document touchscreen text entry among visually impaired Japanese users, including keyboards and speech input.
summary_zh: 问卷记录日本视障用户的触屏文字输入情况，包括屏幕键盘、实体键盘与语音输入。
summary_ja: 質問紙で日本の視覚障害者のタッチ画面入力を調べ、キーボードと音声入力の利用を記録する。
summary_ko: 설문으로 일본 시각장애인의 터치 화면 입력을 조사하고 키보드와 음성 입력 사용을 기록한다.

title: R&D of the Japanese input method using life log on an eye-controlled communication device for users with disabilities
authors: Shoji, K.
venue: Phycs 2014 Proceedings of the International Conference on Physiological Computing Systems
summary_en: Life-log information is proposed for prediction in gaze-based Japanese entry; prediction experiments use examples and simulated priorities.
summary_zh: 利用生活日志辅助眼控日文输入的预测，预测实验采用示例及模拟优先级。
summary_ja: 生活ログを視線入力の予測に利用する。予測実験には例文と模擬優先順位を用いる。
summary_ko: 생활 로그를 시선 입력 예측에 활용하며 예측 실험은 예문과 모의 우선순위를 사용한다.

title: Older adults' text entry on smartphones and tablets: investigating effects of display size and input method on acceptance and performance
authors: Zhou, Jia and Rau, Pei-Luen Patrick and Salvendy, Gavriel
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction
summary_en: Older adults enter Chinese messages on phones and tablets; the study examines device size, input method and task completion.
summary_zh: 老年用户在手机和平板上输入中文信息，研究考察设备尺寸、输入方式与任务完成情况。
summary_ja: 高齢者の中国語メッセージ入力について、端末サイズ・入力方法・課題完了を調べる。
summary_ko: 고령자의 중국어 메시지 입력에서 기기 크기, 입력 방식, 과제 수행을 조사한다.

title: The designs and applications of a scanning interface with electrical signal detection on the scalp for the severely disabled
authors: Lin, Chern-Sheng and Lin, Jung-Chih and Huang, Yen-Chen and Lai, Yu-Chen and Chang, Hsing-Cheng
venue: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine
summary_en: Scalp electrical signals control scanning selection of Zhuyin symbols. The reported output is phonetic symbols rather than selected Han characters.
summary_zh: 头皮电信号控制扫描选择注音符号；报告的输出为注音符号，尚非经候选选择后的汉字。
summary_ja: 頭皮電気信号で注音記号を走査選択する。出力は選択済み漢字ではなく表音記号である。
summary_ko: 두피 전기 신호로 주음 기호를 스캐닝 선택한다. 출력은 선택된 한자가 아닌 표음 기호이다.

title: IT-based touch panel cognition and development for the visually impaired: an experimental study in Taiwan
authors: Tang, J.
venue: Cognition, Technology & Work
summary_en: Six-dot touchscreen Braille is matched to Chinese phonetic symbols and words for messaging, with audio confirmation and editing controls.
summary_zh: 触屏六点盲文匹配中文注音符号与词语，用于短信输入，并提供语音确认和编辑功能。
summary_ja: 画面上の6点点字を中国語の音や語に対応させ、音声確認と編集を備えたメッセージ入力に使う。
summary_ko: 화면의 6점 점자를 중국어 음과 단어에 대응시켜 음성 확인 및 편집 기능이 있는 메시지 입력에 사용한다.

title: A preliminary study on instructional design of Chinese input method for blind students
authors: Wang, Jan-Li and Weng, Teng-Hua and Hwang, Sheue-Ling and Huang, Cin-Wei and Young, Shwu-Ching
venue: Journal of Computers in Education
summary_en: Instruction combines screen-reader feedback and tactile character structure to teach Chinese phonetic and shape-based input methods.
summary_zh: 教学结合屏幕朗读反馈和可触摸的汉字结构，帮助学习中文注音及形码输入法。
summary_ja: 読み上げと触覚的な文字構造教材で、中国語の表音・字形入力を教える。
summary_ko: 화면 읽기와 촉각 문자 구조 교재로 중국어 표음·형태 입력을 가르친다.

title: The attitude of senior adults to text entry of chinese characters on the mobile devices
authors: Xie, Bingjun and Zhou, Jia and Chen, Zhe
venue: 2017 5th International Conference on Enterprise Systems (ES)
summary_en: Older adults use their preferred keyboard, handwriting or speech methods for mixed-content Chinese messages; difficulties include rewriting and switching.
summary_zh: 老年用户以习惯的键盘、手写或语音方式输入含多种字符的中文消息，研究记录重写与切换等困难。
summary_ja: 高齢者が普段のキーボード・手書き・音声で中国語を入力し、書き直しや切替の困難を調べる。
summary_ko: 고령자가 익숙한 키보드, 필기, 음성으로 중국어를 입력하며 다시 쓰기와 전환의 어려움을 조사한다.

title: C-SAK: Chinese Scanning Ambiguous Keyboard for Parkinson's Disease Patients
authors: Jabeen, Farzana and Tao, Linmi and Wang, Xinyue and Mei, Shanshan
venue: 2018 IEEE 16th Intl Conf on Dependable, Autonomic and Secure Computing, 16th Intl Conf on Pervasive Intelligence and Computing, 4th Intl Conf on Big Data Intelligence and Computing and Cyber Science and Technology Congress(DASC/PiCom/DataCom/CyberSciTech)
summary_en: A scanning interface moves from consonants and syllables to Chinese candidates, with association, deletion and speech playback.
summary_zh: 扫描界面依次选择声母、音节和汉字候选，并提供联想、删除与语音播放。
summary_ja: 走査で子音・音節・漢字候補を順に選び、連想・削除・読み上げを利用する。
summary_ko: 스캐닝으로 자음, 음절, 한자 후보를 순서대로 선택하며 연상, 삭제, 읽기를 지원한다.

title: Modeling Chinese Input Interaction for Patients with Cloud Based Learning
authors: Jabeen, Farzana and Tao, Linmi and Lin, Tong and Mei, Shanshan
venue: 2019 IEEE SmartWorld, Ubiquitous Intelligence & Computing, Advanced & Trusted Computing, Scalable Computing & Communications, Cloud & Big Data Computing, Internet of People and Smart City Innovation (SmartWorld/SCALCOM/UIC/ATC/CBDCom/IOP/SCI)
summary_en: Initial and syllable selection produces Chinese candidates; a character language model ranks replacements within sentences.
summary_zh: 通过声母和音节选择生成汉字候选，字符语言模型对句中的替换候选进行排序。
summary_ja: 声母・音節から漢字候補を生成し、文字言語モデルで文中の置換候補を順位付けする。
summary_ko: 성모와 음절로 한자 후보를 생성하고 문자 언어 모델로 문장 내 대체 후보를 정렬한다.

title: Enabling Visually Impaired Peoples' Chinese Typing & Searching Skills: 2nd Year Results in the Longitudinal Study
authors: Liao, Yu-Hsien and Young, Shelley Shwu-Ching and Wang, Jian-Li
venue: 2019 8th International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics (IIAI-AAI)
summary_en: A longitudinal teaching study uses screen-reader support for Chinese keyboard typing and information search, including Zhuyin and Boshiamy methods.
summary_zh: 纵向教学研究利用屏幕朗读支持中文键盘输入与信息检索，涉及注音和嘸蝦米输入法。
summary_ja: 縦断的な教育研究で、読み上げを使った注音・嘸蝦米入力と情報検索を支援する。
summary_ko: 종단 교육 연구에서 화면 읽기를 활용한 주음·Boshiamy 입력과 정보 검색을 지원한다.

title: A Brain-Controlled Chinese Pinyin Input Platform
authors: Lv, Zhilei and Guo, Hong and Huang, Zhihua
venue: 2019 12th International Congress on …
summary_en: A brain-controlled Pinyin interface selects initials, finals, tones and Han candidates across successive displays.
summary_zh: 脑控拼音界面在连续界面中选择声母、韵母、声调和汉字候选。
summary_ja: 脳制御の拼音画面で声母・韻母・声調・漢字候補を段階的に選択する。
summary_ko: 뇌 제어 병음 화면에서 성모, 운모, 성조, 한자 후보를 단계적으로 선택한다.

title: Vipboard: Improving screen-reader keyboard for visually impaired people with character-level auto correction
authors: Shi, Weinan and Yu, Chun and Fan, Shuyi and Wang, Feng and Wang, Tong and Yi, Xin and Bi, Xiaojun and Shi, Yuanchun
venue: Proceedings of the 2019 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: Vipboard corrects Pinyin entry before Chinese conversion and supports candidate gestures. Its reported speed excludes Han-candidate selection time.
summary_zh: Vipboard 在中文转换前纠正拼音输入，并支持候选操作手势；其报告速度不包含汉字候选选择时间。
summary_ja: 拼音修正後に漢字変換し、候補をジェスチャー操作する。報告速度には漢字選択時間を含まない。
summary_ko: 병음 수정 후 한자로 변환하고 제스처로 후보를 조작한다. 보고 속도에는 한자 선택 시간이 포함되지 않는다.

title: An asynchronous hybrid spelling approach based on EEG–EOG signals for Chinese character input
authors: Yu, Yang and Liu, Yadong and Yin, Erwei and Jiang, Jun and Zhou, Zongtan and Hu, Dewen
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
summary_en: EEG spelling is activated by triple blinks, while double blinks select predicted Chinese characters.
summary_zh: 三次眨眼激活脑电拼写，双次眨眼用于选择预测汉字。
summary_ja: 3回の瞬目でEEG綴り入力を起動し、2回の瞬目で予測漢字を選択する。
summary_ko: 세 번 눈을 깜박여 EEG 철자 입력을 시작하고 두 번 깜박여 예측 한자를 선택한다.

title: 'Write'but not 'spell'Chinese characters with a BCI-controlled robot
authors: Han, Jin and Xu, Minpeng and Wang, Yijun and Tang, Jiabei and Liu, Miao and An, Xingwei and Jung, Tzyy-Ping and Ming, Dong
venue: 2020 42nd Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine & Biology Society (EMBC)
summary_en: Brain-controlled coordinate selections guide a robot to draw the strokes of 福. The output is a physical glyph, not editable encoded text.
summary_zh: 脑控坐标选择引导机器人绘制“福”的笔画；输出是物理字形，并非可编辑的编码文字。
summary_ja: 脳制御で座標を選び、ロボットが福の筆画を描く。出力は編集可能な文字コードではなく物理的字形である。
summary_ko: 뇌 제어로 좌표를 선택해 로봇이 福의 획을 그린다. 출력은 편집 가능한 문자 코드가 아닌 물리적 글자 형태이다.

title: Effects of text input methods on performance in operating handheld devices between young and elderly users
authors: Wang, An-Hsiang and Lin, Hsin-Yu and Xiao, Sheng-He
venue: Displays
summary_en: Younger and older users enter traditional Chinese on handheld devices using Zhuyin or handwriting, under timed task conditions.
summary_zh: 年轻和年长用户在限时任务中，通过注音或手写在手持设备上输入繁体中文。
summary_ja: 若年者と高齢者が制限時間内に携帯端末で注音または手書きによる繁体字入力を行う。
summary_ko: 젊은 사용자와 고령자가 제한 시간 안에 휴대 기기에서 주음 또는 필기로 번체자를 입력한다.

title: The design of electronic braille system based on weighted viterbi algorithm
authors: Sun, Binghe and Luo, Wencong and Zhao, Lei and Zhao, Yuxuan and Jiang, Beiyan
venue: 2022 18th International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Security (CIS)
summary_en: Six Braille keys are stored as Unicode Braille, mapped through Pinyin and converted to Chinese text for the clipboard.
summary_zh: 六键盲文先存储为 Unicode 盲文符号，经拼音映射转换为中文，再输出到剪贴板。
summary_ja: 6キー点字をUnicode点字として保存し、拼音を介して漢字に変換してクリップボードへ送る。
summary_ko: 6키 점자를 유니코드 점자로 저장하고 병음을 거쳐 한자로 변환하여 클립보드에 보낸다.

title: The Establishment and Evaluation of a Multi-Learning System to Assist the Congenitally Blind to Use the Boshiamy Method to Input Chinese Characters
authors: Weng, Teng-Hua and Hwang, Sheue-Ling and Wang, Jan-Li
venue: Applied Human Factors and Ergonomics International
summary_en: Audio descriptions and structured learning materials teach congenitally blind learners to enter traditional Chinese using Boshiamy shape codes.
summary_zh: 通过语音描述及结构化教材，教授先天盲人以嘸蝦米形码输入繁体中文。
summary_ja: 音声説明と構造化教材で、先天盲の学習者に嘸蝦米の字形符号による繁体字入力を教える。
summary_ko: 음성 설명과 체계적인 교재로 선천성 시각장애 학습자에게 Boshiamy 형태 코드를 이용한 번체자 입력을 가르친다.

title: Enabling Visually Impaired People's Chinese Literacy learning through Information Technology
authors: YOUNG, Shelley Shwu-Ching and WANG, Jen-Li
venue: International Conference on Computers in Education
summary_en: Screen-reader-supported Chinese typing and web search are used in literacy learning; this report does not specify the underlying input method.
summary_zh: 研究将屏幕朗读支持的中文输入与网页检索用于识字学习；本篇未明确所用输入法。
summary_ja: 読み上げ支援の中国語入力と検索を識字学習に使う。具体的な入力法は本報告では明示されない。
summary_ko: 화면 읽기 지원 중국어 입력과 검색을 문자 학습에 활용한다. 구체적 입력법은 이 보고서에 명시되지 않는다.

title: Handwriting on touch screens through fingers and stylus: Investigating the optimal size of the input box for younger and older adults
authors: Chen, Zhe and Yun, Dongjie and Zhou, Jia
venue: International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction
summary_en: Finger and stylus handwriting are compared across input-box sizes. The evaluated task is single-character recognition and rewriting.
summary_zh: 比较不同输入框尺寸下的手指与触笔手写，评估任务为单字识别及重写。
summary_ja: 入力枠の大きさ別に指とペンを比較する。課題は単字認識と書き直しである。
summary_ko: 입력 칸 크기에 따라 손가락과 펜을 비교하며 과제는 단일 문자 인식과 다시 쓰기이다.

title: Study on Wearable Gaze-Based Communication System for Patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
authors: Nonoka, Sawada and Uehara, Akira and Kawamoto, Hiroaki and Sankai, Yoshiyuki
venue: 2024 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary_en: Wearable gaze control selects Japanese consonant and vowel groups, with kana modifiers, deletion and spoken feedback.
summary_zh: 可穿戴眼控系统选择日文辅音与元音组，并提供假名修饰、删除及语音反馈。
summary_ja: 装着型視線装置で子音・母音群を選び、仮名修飾・削除・音声確認を行う。
summary_ko: 착용형 시선 장치로 자음·모음군을 선택하고 가나 변형, 삭제, 음성 확인을 수행한다.

title: Rectus Femoris and Gastrocnemius EMG Driven Cheonjiin Speller for Korean Text Input
authors: Ahn, Ji Won and Yu, Gi Yeon and Kim, Seong-Wan and Seok, Young-Seek and Choi, Seung Ho
venue: Sensors
summary_en: Leg-muscle EMG triggers cursor and selection commands on a Cheonjiin keyboard to compose Hangul syllables.
summary_zh: 腿部肌电触发 Cheonjiin 键盘的光标与选择命令，用于组合 Hangul 音节。
summary_ja: 脚の筋電でCheonjiinのカーソルと選択を操作し、Hangul音節を組み立てる。
summary_ko: 다리 근전도로 천지인 키보드의 커서와 선택을 제어하여 한글 음절을 조합한다.

title: The Influence of Input Method and Chinese Character Complexity on the Elderly Using Smartphones to Input Information–A Study from China
authors: Liu, Yixuan and Wu, Jinchun and Wang, Xiaoyu and Pan, Chen and Chen, Zihe and Xue, Chengqi
venue: International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction
summary_en: Older adults enter Chinese strings using Pinyin keyboards or handwriting; character complexity and method are examined through time, accuracy and deletion.
summary_zh: 老年用户通过拼音键盘或手写输入中文字符串，研究以时间、准确率及删除操作考察字形复杂度与输入方式。
summary_ja: 高齢者の拼音・手書き入力で、漢字の複雑さと入力法を時間・正確さ・削除から調べる。
summary_ko: 고령자의 병음·필기 입력에서 한자 복잡도와 입력법을 시간, 정확도, 삭제 횟수로 조사한다.

title: Online writing-box-free recognition of handwritten Japanese text considering character size variations
authors: Fukushima, T. and Nakagawa, M.
venue: Proceedings 15th International Conference on Pattern Recognition. ICPR-2000
summary_en: Continuous handwritten Japanese is jointly segmented and recognized using shape, character size and contextual likelihoods in a candidate lattice.
summary_zh: 通过候选词格，联合利用字形、字符尺寸和上下文概率，对连续日文手写进行分割与识别。
summary_ja: 候補格子で字形・大きさ・文脈確率を組み合わせ、連続日本語手書きを同時に分割・認識する。
summary_ko: 후보 격자에서 형태, 크기, 문맥 확률을 결합하여 연속 일본어 필기를 동시에 분할·인식한다.

title: Kana-kanji conversion system with input support based on prediction
authors: Ichimura, Y. and Saito, Y. and Kimura, K. and others
venue: COLING 2000 Volume 1 …
summary_en: Partial kana input predicts Kanji strings; accepted phrases are learned into a prioritized personal dictionary.
summary_zh: 依据部分假名预测汉字字符串，并将用户接受的短语学习到优先使用的个人词典中。
summary_ja: 部分的な仮名から漢字列を予測し、採用語句を優先度付き個人辞書に学習する。
summary_ko: 부분 가나로 한자열을 예측하고 채택된 구절을 우선순위가 있는 개인 사전에 학습한다.

title: Context-dependent substroke model for HMM-based on-line handwriting recognition
authors: Tokuno, J. and Inami, N. and Matsuda, S. and Nakai, M. and others
venue: … in Handwriting …
summary_en: Handwritten Kanji trajectories are decoded using context-dependent substroke HMMs. Context refers to adjacent substrokes, not sentence meaning.
summary_zh: 使用依赖上下文的子笔画隐马尔可夫模型解码汉字手写轨迹；上下文指相邻子笔画，并非句意。
summary_ja: 文脈依存の部分筆画HMMで漢字軌跡を認識する。文脈は隣接筆画であり文意ではない。
summary_ko: 문맥 의존 부분 획 HMM으로 한자 궤적을 인식한다. 문맥은 인접 획이며 문장 의미가 아니다.

title: Candidate Display Styles in Japanese Input.
authors: Ren, Xiangshi and Tamura, Kinya and Kong, Jing and Zhai, Shumin
venue: INTERACT
summary_en: Romaji-to-Kanji input is used to compare candidate-list presentation and paging, with selection and repair timed separately.
summary_zh: 通过罗马字转汉字任务比较候选列表呈现与翻页方式，并分别计量选择和修正时间。
summary_ja: ローマ字から漢字への入力で候補表示と改ページを比較し、選択と修正の時間を分けて測る。
summary_ko: 로마자에서 한자로 입력하며 후보 표시와 페이지 이동을 비교하고 선택·수정 시간을 별도로 측정한다.

title: Japanese college students' typing speed on mobile devices
authors: Houser, C. and Thornton, P.
venue: The 2nd IEEE International Workshop on Wireless and Mobile Technologies in Education, 2004. Proceedings.
summary_en: Japanese entry speeds are compared across devices using equivalent Romaji keystrokes; these rates are not direct Kanji-per-minute measures.
summary_zh: 以等效罗马字按键数比较不同设备的日文输入速度，该指标并非直接的每分钟汉字数。
summary_ja: 等価ローマ字打鍵数で端末間の日本語速度を比較する。直接の漢字毎分指標ではない。
summary_ko: 등가 로마자 타건 수로 기기 간 일본어 입력 속도를 비교하며 직접적인 분당 한자 수는 아니다.

title: A statistical model for Hangeul-Hanja conversion in terminology domain
authors: Huang, J.-X. and Bae, S.-M. and Choi, K.-S.
venue: Proceedings of the 3rd Sighan Workshop on Chinese Language Processing Sighan@acl 2004 Held in Cooperation with Acl 2004
summary_en: A statistical decoder converts Hangeul into mixed Hanja and Hangeul, jointly handling word boundaries and whether a term should be converted.
summary_zh: 统计解码器将 Hangeul 转为 Hanja 与 Hangeul 混合文字，同时处理词界及词语是否需要转换。
summary_ja: 統計復号でHangeulをHanja混じり文へ変換し、語境界と変換すべき語を同時に扱う。
summary_ko: 통계 디코딩으로 한글을 한자·한글 혼합문으로 변환하며 단어 경계와 변환할 단어를 함께 처리한다.

title: Menu-selection-based japanese input method with consonants for pen-based computers
authors: Sato, Daisuke and Shizuki, Buntarou and Miura, Motoki and Tanaka, Jiro
venue: Computer Human Interaction
summary_en: Stylus menus enter consonants; optional vowels narrow Japanese candidates, while dictionaries provide completion and next-word prediction.
summary_zh: 触笔菜单输入辅音，可补充元音缩小日文候选范围，词典支持补全及后续词预测。
summary_ja: ペンメニューで子音を入力し、母音の追加で候補を絞る。辞書で補完と次語予測を行う。
summary_ko: 펜 메뉴로 자음을 입력하고 모음을 추가해 후보를 좁힌다. 사전으로 자동 완성과 다음 단어 예측을 제공한다.

title: Corpus-based predictive text input
authors: Komatsu, H. and Takabayashi, S. and Masui, T.
venue: Proceedings of the 2005 International Conference on Active Media Technology, 2005. (AMT 2005).
summary_en: Text observed in documents supplies compound-word completions, ranked using the current context and typed pronunciation prefixes.
summary_zh: 从文档中观察到的文本提供复合词补全，并结合当前上下文及已输入的读音前缀排序。
summary_ja: 文書から得た複合語を、現在の文脈と入力済み読みの接頭部に応じて補完候補として並べる。
summary_ko: 문서에서 얻은 복합어를 현재 문맥과 입력한 발음 접두부에 따라 자동 완성 후보로 정렬한다.

title: An Evaluation of the Method to Detect Erroneous Sentences of “kana-to-kanji” conversion
authors: Araki, Tetsuo and Nozawa, Takamasa and Minobe, Miyako and Ogoshi, Yasuhiro
venue: Proceedings of the 3rd International Symposium on Autonomous Minirobots for Research and Edutainment (AMiRE 2005)
summary_en: Kana–Kanji candidates are checked by converting them back to spoken readings; semantic patterns are also used to detect homonym errors.
summary_zh: 将假名转汉字候选还原为语音读音进行核查，并使用语义模式检测同音词转换错误。
summary_ja: 変換候補を音声の読みに戻して検査し、意味パターンでも同音語の誤変換を検出する。
summary_ko: 변환 후보를 음성 발음으로 되돌려 검사하고 의미 패턴으로도 동음어 오변환을 감지한다.

title: An Evaluation of the Methods to Convert Non-segmented “kana” Strings to “kanji-kana” Strings Using Markov Chain Models
authors: Araki, Tetsuo and Kurano, Masaki and Furukawa, Yasuo and Yamada, Kazuyoshi and Ogoshi, Yasuhiro
venue: Proceedings of the 3rd International Symposium on Autonomous Minirobots for Research and Edutainment (AMiRE 2005)
summary_en: Markov models segment unspaced kana and generate mixed Kanji–kana candidates; word boundaries and conversion correctness are evaluated.
summary_zh: 马尔可夫模型分割无空格假名并生成汉字与假名混合候选，评估词界与转换正确性。
summary_ja: マルコフモデルで未分割の仮名を区切り、仮名漢字候補を生成して境界と正しさを評価する。
summary_ko: 마르코프 모델로 분할되지 않은 가나를 나누고 가나·한자 후보를 생성해 경계와 정확성을 평가한다.

title: The Korean twiddler: one-handed chording text entry for Korean mobile phones
authors: Doo, M. and Lyons, K. and Starner, T.
venue: CHI'06 Extended Abstracts on Human …
summary_en: One-handed chording selects Hangul initials, vowels and final consonants through a syllable-structured key mapping.
summary_zh: 单手和弦按键依据音节结构映射，选择 Hangul 声母、元音和韵尾。
summary_ja: 片手のコード打鍵で、音節構造に沿ってHangulの初声・母音・終声を選ぶ。
summary_ko: 한 손 화음 타건으로 음절 구조에 따라 한글 초성, 모음, 종성을 선택한다.

title: A comparative usability study of two Japanese gaze typing systems
authors: Itoh, K. and Aoki, H. and Hansen, J. P.
venue: Proceedings of the 2006 symposium on Eye …
summary_en: Two gaze interfaces are compared on hiragana communication phrases. The experiment does not evaluate kana–Kanji conversion.
summary_zh: 以平假名交流短语比较两种眼控界面，实验不涉及假名转汉字的评估。
summary_ja: ひらがな通信文で2種類の視線入力を比較する。仮名漢字変換は評価していない。
summary_ko: 히라가나 의사소통 문장으로 두 시선 입력 방식을 비교하며 가나·한자 변환은 평가하지 않는다.

title: Online handwritten kanji recognition based on inter-stroke grammar
authors: Ota, I. and Yamamoto, R. and Sako, S. and Sagayama, S.
venue: Ninth International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR 2007) Vol 2
summary_en: An inter-stroke grammar recognizes isolated Kanji trajectories and accommodates alternate stroke orders.
summary_zh: 笔画间语法识别单个汉字的手写轨迹，并支持不同笔顺。
summary_ja: 筆画間文法で単独漢字の軌跡を認識し、異なる筆順にも対応する。
summary_ko: 획 사이 문법으로 단일 한자 궤적을 인식하며 다른 획순도 지원한다.

title: A japanese text input interface using on-line writing-box-free handwriting recognition and Kana-to-Kanji conversion
authors: Sakurada, Takeshi and Hagiwara, Yoichi and Oda, Hideto and Nakagawa, Masaki
venue: Human Interface and the Management of Information. Methods, Techniques and Tools in Information Design
summary_en: Free-form ink can be segmented, merged and recognized on demand; users then select handwriting or kana–Kanji conversion candidates.
summary_zh: 自由手写墨迹可按需分割、合并及识别，用户随后选择手写识别或假名转汉字候选。
summary_ja: 自由筆記を必要時に分割・結合・認識し、手書き認識または仮名漢字変換の候補を選ぶ。
summary_ko: 자유 필기를 필요할 때 분할·병합·인식하고 필기 인식 또는 가나·한자 변환 후보를 선택한다.

title: Recognition of Hand Writing Japanese Character
authors: Sano, Tetsuya and Ukida, Hiroyuki and Yamamoto, Hideki
venue: 2007 4th IEEE Workshop on Intelligent Data Acquisition and Advanced Computing Systems: Technology and Applications
summary_en: Online brush trajectories are matched against hiragana templates, illustrated with recognition of あ.
summary_zh: 在线毛笔轨迹与平假名模板匹配，文中以识别“あ”为例。
summary_ja: オンラインの筆軌跡をひらがなテンプレートと照合し、あの認識を例示する。
summary_ko: 온라인 붓 궤적을 히라가나 템플릿과 대조하며 あ 인식을 예시로 제시한다.

title: Text input system using online overlapped handwriting recognition for mobile devices
authors: Tonouchi, Y. and Kawamura, A.
venue: … Analysis and Recognition
summary_en: Overlapping hiragana handwriting is recognized stroke by stroke, with gestures for deletion, kana–Kanji conversion and commitment.
summary_zh: 重叠书写的平假名按笔画识别，并用手势执行删除、假名转汉字和提交。
summary_ja: 重ね書きのひらがなを筆画ごとに認識し、削除・漢字変換・確定をジェスチャーで行う。
summary_ko: 겹쳐 쓴 히라가나를 획마다 인식하고 제스처로 삭제, 한자 변환, 확정을 수행한다.

title: Multilingual text entry using automatic language detection
authors: Ehara, Yo and Tanaka-Ishii, Kumiko
venue: Proceedings of the Third International …
summary_en: Automatic language detection switches between language-specific input engines, including Japanese and Chinese conversion back ends.
summary_zh: 自动语言检测在不同语言的输入引擎间切换，其中包括日文和中文转换后端。
summary_ja: 言語を自動検出して各言語の入力エンジンを切り替える。日本語と中国語の変換も含む。
summary_ko: 언어를 자동 감지해 언어별 입력 엔진을 전환하며 일본어와 중국어 변환도 포함한다.

title: Itone: a japanese text input method for a dual joystick game controller
authors: Go, Kentaro and Konishi, Hayato and Matsuura, Yoshisuke
venue: CHI '08 Extended Abstracts on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: Dual joysticks select a Japanese syllabary column and vowel row; releasing commits the character. Conversion exists but is not fully evaluated.
summary_zh: 双摇杆分别选择日语音节表的列和元音行，释放后提交字符；系统具有转换功能，但未进行完整评估。
summary_ja: 2本のジョイスティックで行と母音段を選び、離すと確定する。変換機能の評価は限定的である。
summary_ko: 두 조이스틱으로 행과 모음 위치를 선택하고 놓으면 확정한다. 변환 기능 평가는 제한적이다.

title: Design and evaluation of korean text entry methods for mobile phones
authors: Ilinkin, Ivaylo and Kim, Sunghee
venue: CHI '08 Extended Abstracts on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: A twelve-key mobile layout combines consonant multi-tap with shape-based vowel composition for Hangul entry.
summary_zh: 十二键手机布局结合辅音多击与基于形状的元音组合，实现 Hangul 输入。
summary_ja: 12キー携帯配列で子音の複数回押しと形状に基づく母音合成を組み合わせる。
summary_ko: 12키 휴대전화 배열에서 자음 여러 번 누르기와 형태 기반 모음 조합을 결합한다.

title: Integrated system for Japanese word processing
authors: Mladenov, Radoslav and Karova, Milena
venue: 2008 Conference on Human System Interactions
summary_en: A Japanese word processor combines keyboard entry with dictionary and radical lookup. Stroke-order pictures teach writing; handwriting recognition is not implemented.
summary_zh: 日文文字处理器结合键盘输入、词典及部首查找；笔顺图片用于教学，未实现手写识别。
summary_ja: 日本語ワープロに辞書・部首検索を統合する。筆順画像は教材であり、手書き認識は未実装である。
summary_ko: 일본어 워드프로세서에 사전·부수 검색을 통합한다. 획순 이미지는 교재이며 필기 인식은 구현되지 않았다.

title: Writer adaptation for online handwriting recognition system using virtual examples
authors: Miyao, Hidetoshi and Maruyama, Minoru
venue: 2009 10th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition
summary_en: Virtual examples adapt an online hiragana recognizer to individual writers using separately held-out handwriting samples.
summary_zh: 通过虚拟样本使在线平假名识别器适应不同书写者，并以独立留出的手写样本评估。
summary_ja: 仮想例でひらがな認識器を書き手に適応させ、別に確保した筆記標本で評価する。
summary_ko: 가상 예제로 히라가나 인식기를 필자에 적응시키고 별도 필기 표본으로 평가한다.

title: Multi-point touch input method for Korean text entry
authors: Shin, Heesook and Lee, Woohun and Lee, Geehyuk and Cho, Ilyeon
venue: CHI '09 Extended Abstracts on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: One- and two-finger button actions are compared for Hangul composition in an image-based interface mockup.
summary_zh: 在基于图像的界面模型中，比较单指与双指按键操作的 Hangul 组合方式。
summary_ja: 画像ベースの模擬画面で、1本指と2本指の操作によるHangul合成を比較する。
summary_ko: 이미지 기반 모의 화면에서 한 손가락과 두 손가락 조작을 이용한 한글 조합을 비교한다.

title: Evaluation of text entry methods for Korean mobile phones, a user study
authors: Ilinkin, Ivaylo and Kim, Sunghee
venue: Proceedings of the SIGCHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: A user study compares Korean mobile keypad methods; reported character-based rates refer to component letters rather than whole Hangul syllables.
summary_zh: 用户研究比较韩文手机键盘输入法，报告的字符速率针对组成字母，并非完整 Hangul 音节。
summary_ja: 韓国語携帯入力を比較する。報告速度の文字単位は完成音節ではなく構成字母である。
summary_ko: 한국어 휴대전화 입력을 비교하며 보고 속도의 문자 단위는 완성 음절이 아닌 구성 자모이다.

title: Kana-to-kanji conversion method using Markov chain model of words in bunsetsu
authors: Kato, Shozo and Araki, Chikahiro and Hashimukai, Shinichiro and Ogoshi, Yasuhiro and Mori, Mikio and Taniguchi, Shuji
venue: 2010 4th International Universal Communication Symposium
summary_en: A word-based Markov model converts unsegmented kana into mixed Kanji–kana text, evaluated at sentence, word and character levels.
summary_zh: 词级马尔可夫模型将未分词假名转换为汉字与假名混合文本，并在句、词和字符层面评估。
summary_ja: 語単位のマルコフモデルで仮名を仮名漢字混じり文に変換し、文・語・文字別に評価する。
summary_ko: 단어 단위 마르코프 모델로 가나를 가나·한자 혼합문으로 변환하고 문장·단어·문자별로 평가한다.

title: Niboshi for slate devices: a Japanese input method using multi-touch for slate devices
authors: Kimioka, Gimpei and Shizuki, Buntarou and Tanaka, Jiro
venue: Human-Computer Interaction. Interaction Techniques and Environments
summary_en: Multi-touch Japanese entry supports kana and predictive Kanji conversion; eyes-free operation concerns the keys rather than hidden text feedback.
summary_zh: 多点触控日文输入支持假名及预测性汉字转换；免视操作针对按键，文字反馈仍然可见。
summary_ja: マルチタッチで仮名と予測漢字変換を入力する。目を使わない操作はキーに関するもので、文章は見える。
summary_ko: 멀티터치로 가나와 예측 한자 변환을 입력한다. 보지 않는 조작은 키에 관한 것이며 출력 문장은 보인다.

title: Modeless Japanese input method using multiple character sequence features
authors: Ikegami, Y. and Sakurai, Y. and Tsuruta, S.
venue: 2012 Eighth International Conference on Signal Image Technology and Internet Based Systems
summary_en: Sequence features distinguish Japanese and ASCII input and map ASCII to kana. Kanji conversion is a proposed downstream step.
summary_zh: 序列特征区分日文与 ASCII 输入，并将 ASCII 映射为假名；汉字转换属于提出的后续环节。
summary_ja: 系列特徴で日本語とASCIIを分類して仮名へ写像する。漢字変換は後段の構想である。
summary_ko: 시퀀스 특징으로 일본어와 ASCII를 분류해 가나로 매핑한다. 한자 변환은 후속 구상이다.

title: No-look flick: single-handed and eyes-free japanese text input system on touch screens of mobile devices
authors: Fukatsu, Yoshitomo and Shizuki, Buntarou and Tanaka, Jiro
venue: Proceedings of the 15th international conference on Human-computer interaction with mobile devices and services
summary_en: Single-handed flick gestures enter kana for short notes without looking at the keys; the study does not test Kanji conversion.
summary_zh: 单手滑动手势在不看按键的情况下输入短假名笔记，研究未测试汉字转换。
summary_ja: キーを見ず片手フリックで短い仮名メモを入力する。漢字変換は試験していない。
summary_ko: 키를 보지 않고 한 손 플릭으로 짧은 가나 메모를 입력하며 한자 변환은 시험하지 않는다.

title: Designing EdgeWrite versions for Japanese Text Entry
authors: Go, Kentaro and Kinoshita, Yuichiro and Watanabe, Shoichi
venue: 2013 International Conference on Cyberworlds
summary_en: EdgeWrite corner paths encode Japanese phonograms, principally katakana, using stroke order and spatial structure.
summary_zh: EdgeWrite 利用笔顺与空间结构，通过角点路径编码日语表音字符，主要为片假名。
summary_ja: EdgeWriteの角経路が筆順と空間構造で日本語の表音文字、主にカタカナを符号化する。
summary_ko: EdgeWrite 모서리 경로가 획순과 공간 구조로 주로 가타카나인 일본어 표음문자를 부호화한다.

title: Hybrid evaluation method for Korean Character input system in mobile phones
authors: Kim, Insoo and Myung, Rohae
venue: International Journal of Industrial Ergonomics
summary_en: A hybrid evaluation compares mobile Hangul input using rehearsed sentences; trials stop when an error occurs.
summary_zh: 混合评估使用预先练习的句子比较手机 Hangul 输入，出现错误即终止试次。
summary_ja: 練習済みの文で携帯Hangul入力を複合評価し、誤りが生じると試行を中止する。
summary_ko: 연습한 문장으로 휴대전화 한글 입력을 복합 평가하며 오류 발생 시 시행을 중단한다.

title: Using the Web to Train a Mobile Device Oriented Japanese Input Method Editor
authors: Wu, Xianchao and Xiao, Rixin and Chen, Xiaoxin
venue: … Joint Conference on Natural Language …
summary_en: Web-mined compounds and phrases expand Japanese kana–Kanji conversion; cloud candidates are placed ahead of local candidates.
summary_zh: 从网页挖掘复合词与短语以扩展日文假名转汉字，云端候选排在本地候选之前。
summary_ja: Webから複合語や句を採掘して変換を拡張し、クラウド候補をローカル候補より先に置く。
summary_ko: 웹에서 복합어와 구를 추출해 변환을 확장하고 클라우드 후보를 로컬 후보보다 앞에 배치한다.

title: Acquisition process of typing skill using hierarchical materials in the Japanese language
authors: Ashitaka, Yuki and Shimada, Hiroyuki
venue: Attention, Perception, & Psychophysics
summary_en: Hierarchical typing practice links Japanese kana words to Romaji key sequences; actual conversion candidates are not displayed.
summary_zh: 分层打字练习将日文假名词与罗马字按键序列关联，实验不显示实际转换候选。
summary_ja: 階層的練習で仮名語とローマ字打鍵列を結び付ける。実際の変換候補は表示しない。
summary_ko: 계층적 연습으로 가나 단어와 로마자 타건열을 연결하며 실제 변환 후보는 표시하지 않는다.

title: One touch character: a simplified japanese character input method for mobile computing
authors: Higashida, Masanobu and Ishida, Toru and Murakami, Jin'ichi and Oku, Masahiro
venue: 2015 International Conference on Culture and Computing (Culture Computing)
summary_en: Numeric sequences retrieve Japanese words, names and addresses, with candidate display used to resolve ambiguity.
summary_zh: 数字序列检索日文词语、姓名及地址，通过候选呈现消除歧义。
summary_ja: 数字列で日本語の語・名前・住所を検索し、候補表示で曖昧さを解消する。
summary_ko: 숫자열로 일본어 단어, 이름, 주소를 검색하고 후보 표시로 모호성을 해소한다.

title: Hybrid method for modeless Japanese input using N-gram based binary classification and dictionary
authors: Ikegami, Yukino and Tsuruta, Setsuo
venue: Multimedia Tools and Applications
summary_en: N-gram classification and a dictionary distinguish ASCII from kana during mixed Japanese typing, before Kanji conversion.
summary_zh: 在混合日文输入中，使用 N 元模型分类与词典区分 ASCII 和假名，再进入汉字转换环节。
summary_ja: N-gram分類と辞書で日本語の混在入力をASCIIと仮名に分け、その後に漢字変換を行う。
summary_ko: N-gram 분류와 사전으로 혼합 일본어 입력의 ASCII와 가나를 구분한 뒤 한자로 변환한다.

title: An efficient image-aware Kana-Kanji conversion algorithm for Twitter on mobile phones
authors: Matsuhara, Masafumi and Sugawara, Taichi and Chakraborty, Goutam and Mabuchi, Hiroshi
venue: 2015 IEEE 7th International Conference on Awareness Science and Technology (iCAST)
summary_en: A photo attached to a kana-based tweet helps rerank Kanji candidates using similarity to retrieved Twitter images.
summary_zh: 利用假名推文所附照片与检索到的 Twitter 图片之间的相似度，重新排列汉字候选。
summary_ja: 仮名で書いたツイートの添付写真と検索画像の類似度を使い、漢字候補を並べ替える。
summary_ko: 가나 트윗의 첨부 사진과 검색 이미지의 유사도로 한자 후보 순위를 조정한다.

title: Enhanced auditory feedback for Korean touch screen keyboards
authors: Park, Yongki and Heo, Hoon and Lee, Kyogu
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Studies
summary_en: Different sounds provide feedback for Korean touchscreen typing; sentence transcription is tested with automatic completion and correction disabled.
summary_zh: 为韩文触屏输入提供不同声音反馈，在关闭自动补全和自动纠错的条件下测试句子抄录。
summary_ja: 異なる音で韓国語タッチ入力にフィードバックを与える。文の転記実験では自動補完と自動修正を無効にした。
summary_ko: 한국어 터치 입력에 서로 다른 소리 피드백을 제공한다. 문장 전사 실험에서는 자동 완성과 교정을 껐다.

title: Complete as you go: A constructive Korean text entry method for smartwatches
authors: Lee, Ji-Eun and Yoon, Hyoseok and Park, Se-Ho and Lee, Kyung-Taek
venue: 2016 International Conference on Information and Communication Technology Convergence (ICTC)
summary_en: A smartwatch interface constructs Hangul from initial consonants, vowels and final consonants through expandable, frequency-ordered choices.
summary_zh: 智能手表界面以可展开、按频率排列的选项，逐步选择声母、元音和韵尾构成 Hangul。
summary_ja: 展開可能な頻度順の選択肢から初声・母音・終声を選び、腕時計でHangulを合成する。
summary_ko: 스마트워치에서 빈도순으로 펼쳐지는 선택지를 통해 초성·모음·종성을 골라 한글을 조합한다.

title: Mid-Air Hangeul Input System
authors: Han, Kyungjin and Lee, Jongweon
venue: Advances in Human Factors and Systems Interaction
summary_en: Mid-air gestures select consonants and vowels on a large display to compose Hangul, without a head-mounted display.
summary_zh: 通过空中手势选择大屏幕上的辅音和元音，组合 Hangul，系统不使用头戴显示器。
summary_ja: 大型画面で空中ジェスチャーにより子音と母音を選び、Hangulを合成する。HMDは使わない。
summary_ko: 대형 화면에서 공중 제스처로 자음과 모음을 골라 한글을 조합하며 HMD는 사용하지 않는다.

title: Flick: Japanese input method editor using N-gram and recurrent neural network language model based predictive text input
authors: Ikegami, Yukino and Sakurai, Yoshitaka and Damiani, Ernesto and Knauf, Rainer and Tsuruta, Setsuo
venue: 2017 13th International Conference on Signal-Image Technology & Internet-Based Systems (SITIS)
summary_en: A Japanese mobile IME uses word segmentation and recurrent language modeling to predict the next word from the current input and history.
summary_zh: 日文手机输入法通过分词及循环语言模型，结合当前输入和历史词语预测后续词。
summary_ja: 日本語モバイルIMEで単語分割と再帰型言語モデルを用い、現在の入力と履歴から次の語を予測する。
summary_ko: 일본어 모바일 IME에서 단어 분할과 순환 언어 모델로 현재 입력 및 이력에 따른 다음 단어를 예측한다.

title: Evaluation of Korean Text Entry Methods for Smartwatches
authors: Ilinkin, Ivaylo and Kim, Sunghee
venue: Proceedings of the 2017 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: Repeated smartwatch transcription compares Korean entry methods, with corrections deleting individual letters rather than whole syllable blocks.
summary_zh: 通过重复的智能手表抄录任务比较韩文输入法，纠错时删除单个字母，而非整个音节块。
summary_ja: 腕時計での反復転記により韓国語入力方式を比較する。修正時は音節全体ではなく個々の字母を削除する。
summary_ko: 스마트워치에서 반복 전사로 한국어 입력 방식을 비교하며, 수정 시 음절 전체 대신 개별 자모를 지운다.

title: Non-touch character input system based on hand tapping gestures using Kinect sensor
authors: Shin, Jungpil and Kim, Cheol Min
venue: IEEE Access
summary_en: Kinect detects mid-air tapping to enter hiragana or English, with controls for modifiers, deletion, spacing and character-set changes.
summary_zh: Kinect 检测空中拍击以输入平假名或英文，并支持修饰符、删除、空格及字符集切换。
summary_ja: Kinectが空中タップを検出してひらがなや英語を入力する。修飾・削除・空白・文字種切替も備える。
summary_ko: Kinect로 공중 탭을 감지하여 히라가나나 영어를 입력하며 수정 기호·삭제·공백·문자 종류 전환을 지원한다.

title: Online Japanese handwriting recognizers using recurrent neural networks
authors: Nguyen, Hung Tuan and Nguyen, Cuong Tuan and Nakagawa, Masaki
venue: 2018 16th International Conference on Frontiers in Handwriting Recognition (ICFHR)
summary_en: Recurrent networks recognize recorded Japanese handwriting trajectories as characters or text lines; no interactive candidate interface is evaluated.
summary_zh: 循环网络将记录的日文手写轨迹识别为字符或文本行，研究未评估交互式候选界面。
summary_ja: 記録済みの日本語手書き軌跡を再帰型ネットワークで文字や行として認識する。対話的な候補画面は評価しない。
summary_ko: 순환 신경망으로 기록된 일본어 필기 궤적을 문자나 행으로 인식한다. 대화형 후보 인터페이스는 평가하지 않는다.

title: A 2-by-6-Button Japanese Software Keyboard for Tablets.
authors: Takei, Kei and Hosobe, Hiroshi
venue: Proceedings of the 13th International Joint Conference on Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications
summary_en: A two-by-six-button tablet keyboard enters kana, special characters and controls without kana–Kanji conversion.
summary_zh: 二乘六按键的平板键盘用于输入假名、特殊字符及控制命令，不包含假名转汉字。
summary_ja: 2行6列のタブレット用ボタンで仮名・特殊文字・操作を入力する。仮名漢字変換は行わない。
summary_ko: 태블릿의 2행 6열 버튼으로 가나·특수 문자·명령을 입력하며 가나–한자 변환은 하지 않는다.

title: BubbleFlick: Investigating effective interface for Japanese text entry on smartwatches
authors: Tojo, T. and Kato, T. and Yamamoto, S.
venue: … of the 20th International Conference on …
summary_en: Directional flicks on a circular smartwatch keyboard select kana; a central area controls cursor movement and deletion.
summary_zh: 在环形智能手表键盘上以方向滑动选择假名，中央区域用于光标移动与删除。
summary_ja: 円形の腕時計キーボードで方向フリックにより仮名を選び、中央でカーソル移動と削除を操作する。
summary_ko: 원형 스마트워치 키보드에서 방향 플릭으로 가나를 고르고 중앙 영역에서 커서 이동과 삭제를 조작한다.

title: Micro Touch Board Specially Designed for SliT that Is the Japanese Character Input Method for Smartwatches
authors: Tanaka, T. and Saka, K. and Akita, K. and Sagawa, Y.
venue: International Conference on …
summary_en: Sliding chooses a Japanese syllabary row and tapping chooses its vowel position to enter hiragana on a small touch surface.
summary_zh: 在小型触控面上，先滑动选择日语音节行，再点击选择元音位置，输入平假名。
summary_ja: 小さなタッチ面でスライドにより五十音の行を選び、タップで母音位置を指定してひらがなを入力する。
summary_ko: 작은 터치면에서 슬라이드로 오십음도 행을 고르고 탭으로 모음 위치를 지정하여 히라가나를 입력한다.

title: Efficient Speech-Recognition Error-Correction Interface for Japanese Text Entry on Smartwatches
authors: Toba, R. and Kato, T. and Yamamoto, S.
venue: … of the 21st International Conference on …
summary_en: A smartwatch interface repairs Japanese speech-recognition errors using candidate and keyboard operations; re-dictation is prohibited in the test.
summary_zh: 智能手表界面通过候选及键盘操作修正日语语音识别错误，测试中禁止重新口述。
summary_ja: 腕時計で候補選択とキーボード操作により日本語音声認識の誤りを直す。実験では再発話を禁止した。
summary_ko: 스마트워치에서 후보 선택과 키보드 조작으로 일본어 음성 인식 오류를 수정한다. 실험에서는 재발화를 금지했다.

title: A Japanese Bimanual Flick Keyboard for Tablets That Improves Display Space Efficiency.
authors: Nakamura, Yuya and Hosobe, Hiroshi
venue: Proceedings of the 15th International Joint Conference on Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications
summary_en: A bimanual tablet keyboard combines kana flick entry with dictionary-based Kanji conversion and a dedicated candidate area.
summary_zh: 双手平板键盘结合假名滑动输入、基于词典的汉字转换及专门的候选区域。
summary_ja: 両手用タブレットキーボードに仮名フリック、辞書による漢字変換、専用候補領域を組み合わせる。
summary_ko: 양손 태블릿 키보드에 가나 플릭, 사전 기반 한자 변환, 전용 후보 영역을 결합한다.

title: Homonym normalisation by word sense clustering: a case in Japanese
authors: Sato, Yo and Heffernan, Kevin
venue: Proceedings of the 28th International Conference on Computational Linguistics
summary_en: Word-sense clustering normalizes Japanese homonyms for an offline kana–Kanji conversion module.
summary_zh: 通过词义聚类规范日文同音词，用于离线假名转汉字模块。
summary_ja: 語義クラスタリングで日本語の同音語を正規化し、オフラインの仮名漢字変換モジュールに用いる。
summary_ko: 의미 군집화로 일본어 동음어를 정규화하여 오프라인 가나–한자 변환 모듈에 활용한다.

title: A Bimanual Flick-Based Japanese Software Keyboard Using Direct Kanji Input
authors: Nakamura, Yuya and Hosobe, Hiroshi
venue: Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications
summary_en: Common-use Kanji can be selected directly; other Kanji and katakana remain accessible through a conversion area.
summary_zh: 常用汉字可直接选择，其他汉字及片假名仍可通过转换区域输入。
summary_ja: 常用漢字を直接選択でき、その他の漢字とカタカナは変換領域から入力する。
summary_ko: 상용한자를 직접 선택하고 다른 한자와 가타카나는 변환 영역에서 입력한다.

title: A japanese character flick-input interface for entering text in vr
authors: Takahashi, R. and Shirai, S. and Orlosky, J. and others
venue: … on Mixed and …
summary_en: A VR flick interface enters hiragana and displays the sentence; Kanji-candidate conversion is not evaluated.
summary_zh: VR 滑动界面输入平假名并显示句子，未评估汉字候选转换。
summary_ja: VRのフリック画面でひらがなを入力し文を表示する。漢字候補への変換は評価しない。
summary_ko: VR 플릭 인터페이스로 히라가나를 입력하고 문장을 표시한다. 한자 후보 변환은 평가하지 않는다.

title: JoyFlick: Japanese Text Entry Using Dual Joysticks for Flick Input Users
authors: Yokoyama, Kaisei and Takakura, Rei and Shizuki, Buntarou
venue: Human-Computer Interaction – INTERACT 2021
summary_en: Two joysticks and modifier buttons produce Japanese kana. IME integration and VR use are discussed as future extensions.
summary_zh: 两个摇杆与修饰按键用于输入日文假名，接入输入法和 VR 使用属于讨论中的后续扩展。
summary_ja: 2本のジョイスティックと修飾ボタンで日本語の仮名を入力する。IME統合とVR利用は今後の拡張として述べる。
summary_ko: 조이스틱 두 개와 수정 버튼으로 일본어 가나를 입력한다. IME 통합과 VR 활용은 향후 확장으로 논의한다.

title: Fast ML-based next-word prediction for hybrid languages
authors: Ikegami, Yukino and Tsuruta, Setsuo and Kutics, Andrea and Damiani, Ernesto and Knauf, Rainer
venue: Internet of Things
summary_en: A Japanese mobile IME provides recurrent-model word prediction and conversion candidates, compared with Mozc on input time and key actions.
summary_zh: 日文手机输入法提供循环模型词预测及转换候选，并与 Mozc 比较输入时间和按键操作。
summary_ja: 日本語モバイルIMEが再帰型モデルによる語予測と変換候補を提供し、入力時間とキー操作をMozcと比較する。
summary_ko: 일본어 모바일 IME가 순환 모델 기반 단어 예측 및 변환 후보를 제공하며 입력 시간과 키 조작을 Mozc와 비교한다.

title: Alignment-based decoding policy for low-latency and anticipation-free neural japanese input method editors
authors: Sarhangzadeh, Armin and Watanabe, Taro
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics ACL 2024
summary_en: An alignment-based policy incrementally converts kana into Japanese written text while controlling when the decoder reads and writes.
summary_zh: 基于对齐的策略控制解码器读取与输出时机，将假名逐步转换为日文书面文本。
summary_ja: アラインメントに基づく方策で、復号器の読み取りと出力の時機を制御しながら仮名を逐次変換する。
summary_ko: 정렬 기반 정책으로 디코더의 읽기와 출력 시점을 제어하며 가나를 일본어 표기문으로 점진 변환한다.

title: Flick-in: Japanese Text Entry Method for Indirect Touch Using Bezel-Initiated Swipe
authors: Wada, Yuto and Choi, Myungguen and Shirane, Kaoru and Shizuki, Buntarou
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 ACM Symposium on Spatial User Interaction
summary_en: A bezel swipe and indirect touch select Japanese kana on a watch. The illustrated Kanji-conversion extension was not implemented or evaluated.
summary_zh: 通过表框滑动和间接触控在手表上选择日文假名，图示的汉字转换扩展尚未实现或评估。
summary_ja: 腕時計のベゼルスワイプと間接タッチで仮名を選ぶ。図示された漢字変換への拡張は未実装・未評価である。
summary_ko: 스마트워치의 베젤 스와이프와 간접 터치로 가나를 선택한다. 그림에 제시된 한자 변환 확장은 구현·평가되지 않았다.

title: Proposal for Japanese Flick Input in VR Environments Using Pinch Gestures
authors: Kishi, Naoki and Oka, Makoto and Mori, Hirohiko
venue: Human Interface and the Management of Information
summary_en: Pinch gestures operate a VR kana keyboard and an editing mode with deletion, modifiers and conversion-candidate selection.
summary_zh: 捏合手势操控 VR 假名键盘及编辑模式，支持删除、修饰符和转换候选选择。
summary_ja: ピンチでVR仮名キーボードを操作し、編集モードで削除・修飾・変換候補選択を行う。
summary_ko: 핀치로 VR 가나 키보드를 조작하고 편집 모드에서 삭제·수정 기호·변환 후보 선택을 수행한다.

title: A Japanese Software Keyboard for Smartwatches Using Large Keys to Improve Input Accuracy
authors: Mokuya, Yota and Hosobe, Hiroshi
venue: Human-Centered Design, Operation and Evaluation of Mobile Communications
summary_en: Large consonant keys and vowel taps compose kana on a smartwatch; predictive conversion is proposed as future work.
summary_zh: 通过大尺寸辅音键和元音点击在智能手表上组合假名，预测性转换属于后续工作。
summary_ja: 腕時計の大きな子音キーと母音タップで仮名を合成する。予測変換は今後の課題として提案する。
summary_ko: 스마트워치의 큰 자음 키와 모음 탭으로 가나를 조합하며 예측 변환은 향후 과제로 제안한다.

title: KUCHIMOJI: A Japanese Vowel-Based Character Entry System Using Mouth Shape Recognition for Assistive Communication
authors: Takeuchi, Daisuke and Zhang, Haibo and Itoh, Kazuyuki and Saitoh, Takeshi
venue: Electronics
summary_en: Mouth shapes estimate vowels; scanning and confirmation signals select kana. The system supports speech playback, but not Kanji conversion.
summary_zh: 口型用于估计元音，再通过扫描及确认信号选择假名；系统支持语音播放，不包含汉字转换。
summary_ja: 口形から母音を推定し、走査と確認信号で仮名を選ぶ。音声再生を備えるが漢字変換は行わない。
summary_ko: 입 모양으로 모음을 추정하고 스캔 및 확인 신호로 가나를 선택한다. 음성 재생은 지원하지만 한자 변환은 하지 않는다.

title: Entering text with a four-button device
authors: Tanaka-Ishii, K. and Inutsuka, Y. and others
venue: COLING 2002: The 19th …
summary_en: Ambiguous input on four character buttons is resolved through predictive completion and selection from ranked word candidates.
summary_zh: 四个字符按键产生的歧义输入，通过预测补全及排序词候选的选择消解。
summary_ja: 4個の文字ボタンによる曖昧な入力を、予測補完と順位付き単語候補の選択によって解決する。
summary_ko: 문자 버튼 네 개의 모호한 입력을 예측 완성과 순위가 매겨진 단어 후보 선택으로 해소한다.

title: Speech pen: predictive handwriting based on ambient multimodal recognition
authors: Kurihara, Kazutaka and Goto, Masataka and Ogata, Jun and Igarashi, Takeo
venue: Proceedings of the SIGCHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: Ambient speech and handwriting recognition suggest text that can be inserted into Japanese notes in a personalized handwriting style.
summary_zh: 环境语音与手写识别提供文字建议，可按个性化手写风格插入日文笔记。
summary_ja: 周囲の音声と手書きの認識から、日本語ノートに本人の筆跡で挿入できる文字列を提案する。
summary_ko: 주변 음성과 필기를 인식하여 개인 필체로 일본어 노트에 삽입할 텍스트를 제안한다.

title: A Japanese input method for mobile terminals using surface EMG signals
authors: Hatano, Akira and Araki, Kenji and Matsuhara, Masafumi
venue: New Frontiers in Artificial …
summary_en: Surface EMG generates pseudo-key events for Japanese word-candidate selection, paging and confirmation.
summary_zh: 表面肌电生成模拟按键事件，用于日文词候选选择、翻页与确认。
summary_ja: 表面筋電から疑似キー入力を生成し、日本語の単語候補の選択・ページ切替・確定を行う。
summary_ko: 표면 근전도로 가상 키 이벤트를 생성하여 일본어 단어 후보 선택·페이지 전환·확정을 수행한다.

title: P300 based BCI messenger
authors: Li, Yi and Zhang, Jianhui and Su, Yu and Chen, Weidong and Qi, Yu and Zhang, Jicai and Zheng, Xiaoxiang
venue: 2009 ICME International Conference on Complex Medical Engineering
summary_en: A P300 messenger offers Chinese stroke entry, candidate selection and deletion, then sends the resulting message.
summary_zh: P300 消息系统提供中文笔画输入、候选选择及删除，并发送生成的消息。
summary_ja: P300メッセンジャーで中国語の筆画入力、候補選択、削除を行い、完成したメッセージを送る。
summary_ko: P300 메신저에서 중국어 획 입력, 후보 선택, 삭제를 수행하고 완성된 메시지를 전송한다.

title: P300 Chinese input system based on Bayesian LDA.
authors: Jin, Jing and Allison, Brendan Z. and Brunner, Clemens and Wang, Bei and Wang, Xingyu and Zhang, Jianhua and Neuper, Christa and Pfurtscheller, Gert
venue: Biomedizinische Technik/Biomedical Engineering
summary_en: A stroke-to-Chinese candidate interface is designed around P300 classification; the experiment evaluates cued components rather than voluntary messages.
summary_zh: 围绕 P300 分类设计笔画转汉字候选界面，实验评估提示条件下的组件选择，而非自主消息输入。
summary_ja: P300分類に基づく筆画から漢字への候補画面を設計する。実験は自由なメッセージでなく指定部品を評価する。
summary_ko: P300 분류에 따른 획–중국 한자 후보 인터페이스를 설계한다. 실험은 자유 메시지 대신 지정된 구성 요소를 평가한다.

title: Design of eye-typing interface using saccadic latency of eye movement
authors: Kotani, Kentaro and Yamaguchi, Yuji and Asao, Takafumi and Horii, Ken
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction
summary_en: An eye-typing interface selects kana using gaze timing, with written and auditory confirmation; calibration corrects sensor drift.
summary_zh: 眼控打字界面依据注视时序选择假名，并提供文字及声音确认；校准用于修正传感器漂移。
summary_ja: 視線の時間制御で仮名を選び、文字と音で確認する。校正によりセンサーのドリフトを補正する。
summary_ko: 시선 타이밍으로 가나를 선택하고 문자와 소리로 확인한다. 보정으로 센서 드리프트를 수정한다.

title: A P300-based Hangul input system with a hierarchical stimulus presentation paradigm
authors: Lee, Tae-Hoon and Kam, Tae-Eui and Kim, Sung-Phil
venue: 2011 International Workshop on Pattern Recognition in NeuroImaging
summary_en: Hierarchical P300 stimuli select Hangul components in syllable order, with null-final and undo controls.
summary_zh: 分层 P300 刺激按照音节顺序选择 Hangul 组成部分，并提供空韵尾及撤销控制。
summary_ja: 階層型P300刺激で音節順にHangulの構成要素を選び、終声なしと取り消しの操作を備える。
summary_ko: 계층형 P300 자극으로 음절 순서에 따라 한글 구성 요소를 선택하며 종성 없음과 실행 취소를 지원한다.

title: Design of Chinese spelling system based on ERP
authors: Sun, Koun-Tem and Huang, Tzu-Wei and Chen, Min-Chi
venue: 2011 IEEE 11th International Conference on Bioinformatics and Bioengineering
summary_en: ERP-based Zhuyin selection produces traditional Chinese candidates, followed by character selection, paging and deletion.
summary_zh: 基于事件相关电位选择注音符号，生成繁体汉字候选，再进行选字、翻页和删除。
summary_ja: ERPによる注音選択から繁体字候補を生成し、文字選択・ページ切替・削除を行う。
summary_ko: ERP 기반 주음 선택으로 번체 한자 후보를 생성하고 문자 선택·페이지 전환·삭제를 수행한다.

title: Multilingual touchscreen keyboard design and optimization
authors: Bi, Xiaojun and Smith, Barton A and Zhai, Shumin
venue: Human–Computer Interaction
summary_en: Touchscreen layout optimization includes the Roman-letter portion of Pinyin; the Han-candidate phase is excluded and user testing uses English.
summary_zh: 触屏布局优化涵盖拼音的罗马字母输入部分，不包含汉字候选环节，用户实验使用英文。
summary_ja: タッチ配列の最適化に拼音のローマ字部分を含む。漢字候補段階は対象外で、ユーザー実験は英語で行う。
summary_ko: 터치 배열 최적화에 병음의 로마자 부분을 포함한다. 한자 후보 단계는 제외하며 사용자 실험은 영어로 진행한다.

title: Eye typing of Chinese characters
authors: Liang, Zhen and Fu, Qiang and Chi, Zheru
venue: Proceedings of the Symposium on Eye Tracking Research and Applications
summary_en: Gaze selects Pinyin keys and Chinese phrase candidates, with paging, punctuation and backspace controls.
summary_zh: 通过注视选择拼音按键及中文词组候选，并提供翻页、标点和退格功能。
summary_ja: 視線で拼音キーと中国語句候補を選び、ページ切替・句読点・後退削除を操作する。
summary_ko: 시선으로 병음 키와 중국어 구 후보를 선택하고 페이지 전환·문장 부호·백스페이스를 조작한다.

title: A Chinese text input brain–computer interface based on the P300 speller
authors: Minett, James W. and Zheng, Hong-Ying and Fong, Manson C-M. and Zhou, Lin and Peng, Gang and Wang, William S-Y.
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction
summary_en: Three-stage P300 selection composes traditional Chinese characters from components. The experimental protocol prohibits repairing component errors.
summary_zh: 三阶段 P300 选择通过部件构成繁体汉字，实验协议禁止修正部件选择错误。
summary_ja: 3段階のP300選択で構成要素から繁体字を合成する。実験では構成要素の誤りの修正を禁止した。
summary_ko: 3단계 P300 선택으로 구성 요소를 조합해 번체 한자를 만든다. 실험에서는 구성 요소 오류 수정을 금지했다.

title: A cursor control based chinese-english BCI speller
authors: Chen, Conghui and Yang, Jing and Huang, Yanbing and Li, Jie and Xia, Bin
venue: Neural Information Processing
summary_en: Motor-imagery cursor control selects Pinyin letters; a Chinese IME converts them into Han text for messaging.
summary_zh: 运动想象控制光标选择拼音字母，由中文输入法转换为汉字并用于消息发送。
summary_ja: 運動想像でカーソルを動かして拼音字母を選び、中国語IMEで漢字へ変換してメッセージを作る。
summary_ko: 운동 상상으로 커서를 움직여 병음 글자를 선택하고 중국어 IME로 한자로 변환하여 메시지를 작성한다.

title: KooSHO: Japanese Text Input Environment based on Aerial Hand Writing
authors: Hagiwara, Masato and Masuko, Soh
venue: Proceedings of the 2013 NAACL HLT …
summary_en: Aerial letter trajectories form a lattice; consonant decoding produces Kanji candidates that users touch to submit a search query.
summary_zh: 空中字母轨迹形成词格，辅音解码生成汉字候选，用户触及候选后提交检索式。
summary_ja: 空中で描く字母軌跡から格子を作り、子音の復号で漢字候補を生成する。利用者はタッチで検索語を確定する。
summary_ko: 공중에 쓴 글자 궤적으로 격자를 만들고 자음 디코딩으로 한자 후보를 생성한다. 사용자는 터치로 검색어를 확정한다.

title: The fastest BCI for writing Chinese characters using brain waves
authors: Huang, T.W. and Tai, Y.H. and Tian, Y.J. and Sun, K.T.
venue: 2013 Fourth Global Congress on Intelligent Systems
summary_en: Brain-wave selection enters Zhuyin before switching to Chinese candidates; the reported experiment measures item selections, not complete sentences.
summary_zh: 通过脑电选择输入注音，再切换到汉字候选；报告的实验计量项目选择，并非完整句子输入。
summary_ja: 脳波で注音を選んでから漢字候補へ切り替える。報告実験は文全体ではなく項目選択を測定する。
summary_ko: 뇌파로 주음을 선택한 뒤 한자 후보로 전환한다. 보고된 실험은 전체 문장 대신 항목 선택을 측정한다.

title: A P300-based brain–computer interface for Chinese character input
authors: Yu, Yang and Zhou, Zongtan and Yin, Erwei and Jiang, Jun and Liu, Yadong and Hu, Dewen
venue: International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction
summary_en: P300 selection moves from Pinyin initials and finals to frequency-ranked Han characters, with prediction, paging and repair controls.
summary_zh: P300 选择从拼音声母和韵母进入按频率排列的汉字候选，支持预测、翻页与修正。
summary_ja: P300で拼音の声母・韻母から頻度順の漢字へ進む。予測・ページ切替・修正の操作を備える。
summary_ko: P300으로 병음 성모·운모에서 빈도순 한자로 진행하며 예측·페이지 전환·수정을 지원한다.

title: An eighty-target high-speed Chinese BCI speller
authors: Han, Chengcheng and Xu, Guanghua and Xie, Jun and Li, Min and Zhang, Sicong and Luo, Ailing
venue: 2017 39th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
summary_en: An eighty-target brain speller first selects a Pinyin range, then a Chinese homophone candidate, with extra commands for correction.
summary_zh: 八十目标脑控拼写器先选择拼音范围，再选择同音汉字候选，并以额外命令纠错。
summary_ja: 80標的の脳波スペラーでまず拼音範囲、次に同音漢字候補を選び、修正用の追加命令を備える。
summary_ko: 80개 표적의 뇌파 스펠러에서 병음 범위를 고른 뒤 동음 한자 후보를 선택하며 추가 교정 명령을 지원한다.

title: In-air handwritten Chinese text recognition with temporal convolutional recurrent network
authors: Gan, Ji and Wang, Weiqiang and Lu, Ke
venue: Pattern Recognition
summary_en: Continuous in-air Chinese handwriting is projected and decoded into text using temporal convolution, recurrent modeling and a language model.
summary_zh: 连续空中中文手写经投影后，结合时序卷积、循环建模及语言模型解码为文本。
summary_ja: 連続した空中の中国語手書きを投影し、時間畳み込み・再帰モデル・言語モデルで文字列に復号する。
summary_ko: 연속 공중 중국어 필기를 투영하고 시간 합성곱·순환 모델·언어 모델로 텍스트를 디코딩한다.

title: An approach to detecting ErrP elicited by feedback of P300 Speller BCI based on coefficients of determination
authors: Li, Ting and Huang, Zhihua
venue: 2020 13th International Congress on Image and Signal Processing, BioMedical Engineering and Informatics (CISP-BMEI)
summary_en: The study detects error-related brain responses during Pinyin-component spelling; it does not demonstrate automatic repair of final Han text.
summary_zh: 研究检测拼音组件拼写中的错误相关脑反应，未展示最终汉字文本的自动修正。
summary_ja: 拼音構成要素の入力時に生じる誤り関連脳反応を検出する。最終漢字の自動修正は実証しない。
summary_ko: 병음 구성 요소 입력 중 오류 관련 뇌 반응을 검출한다. 최종 한자 텍스트의 자동 교정은 입증하지 않는다.

title: Steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP)-based brain–computer interface (BCI) of Chinese speller for a patient with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: A case …
authors: Shi, Nanlin and Wang, Liping and Chen, Yonghao and Yan, Xinyi and Yang, Chen and Wang, Yijun and Gao, Xiaorong
venue: Journal of Neurorestoratology
summary_en: An SSVEP interface combines Pinyin entry and Han-candidate selection for home communication by a person with ALS.
summary_zh: SSVEP 界面结合拼音输入与汉字候选选择，支持一名 ALS 患者在家中交流。
summary_ja: SSVEP画面で拼音入力と漢字候補選択を組み合わせ、ALS当事者の家庭内コミュニケーションを支援する。
summary_ko: SSVEP 인터페이스로 병음 입력과 한자 후보 선택을 결합하여 ALS 당사자의 가정 내 소통을 지원한다.

title: A calibration-free P300 BCI system using an on-line updating classifier based on reinforcement learning
authors: Guo, Jiannan and Huang, Zhihua
venue: 2021 14th International Congress on Image and Signal Processing, BioMedical Engineering and Informatics (CISP-BMEI)
summary_en: An updating P300 classifier supports cued Pinyin and Chinese-word selections, using known copy targets as rewards.
summary_zh: 动态更新的 P300 分类器支持提示条件下的拼音及中文词语选择，并以已知抄录目标提供奖励。
summary_ja: 更新型P300分類器が指定された拼音と中国語単語の選択を支援し、既知の転記対象を報酬として用いる。
summary_ko: 갱신형 P300 분류기가 지정된 병음과 중국어 단어 선택을 지원하며 알려진 전사 대상을 보상으로 사용한다.

title: Effectiveness of an eye-gaze controlled typing system for the japanese syllabary
authors: Ogata, Kohichi and Inoue, Shuto
venue: … Journal of Innovative Computing, Information and …
summary_en: Gaze-controlled Romaji keys send Japanese kana to text editors, including modifiers and deletion; Kanji conversion is not evaluated.
summary_zh: 眼控罗马字按键将日文假名发送至文本编辑器，并支持修饰与删除；未评估汉字转换。
summary_ja: 視線操作のローマ字キーから日本語の仮名をエディターへ送り、修飾と削除も行う。漢字変換は評価しない。
summary_ko: 시선으로 조작하는 로마자 키로 일본어 가나를 편집기에 입력하며 수정 기호와 삭제를 지원한다. 한자 변환은 평가하지 않는다.

title: A calibration-free approach to implementing P300-based brain–computer interface
authors: Huang, Zhihua and Guo, Jiannan and Zheng, Wenming and Wu, Yingjie and Lin, Zhixiong and Zheng, Huiru
venue: Cognitive Computation
summary_en: A transfer-based P300 classifier selects Pinyin initials, finals and tones under cued spelling; free-composition correction is not demonstrated.
summary_zh: 基于迁移的 P300 分类器在提示式拼写中选择拼音声母、韵母和声调，未展示自由表达中的纠错。
summary_ja: 転移型P300分類器が指示入力で拼音の声母・韻母・声調を選ぶ。自由作文での修正は実証しない。
summary_ko: 전이 기반 P300 분류기가 지정 입력에서 병음 성모·운모·성조를 선택한다. 자유 작문의 교정은 입증하지 않는다.

title: A practical hybrid BCI speller for Chinese Character Input: Integrating an Eye Tracker into a P300-Based Spelling approach
authors: Li, Hao and Fang, Xun and Ye, Zeqi and Chu, Xingxing and Lu, Gai and Yu, Yang
venue: Proceedings of the 5th International Conference on Computer Science and Software Engineering
summary_en: P300 selects Pinyin initials and finals; eye tracking then selects the Chinese character from a homophone list.
summary_zh: P300 选择拼音声母和韵母，随后由眼动从同音字列表中选择汉字。
summary_ja: P300で拼音の声母と韻母を選び、続いて視線で同音字一覧から漢字を選ぶ。
summary_ko: P300으로 병음 성모와 운모를 선택한 뒤 시선 추적으로 동음자 목록에서 한자를 고른다.

title: The Interface Design of Chinese Input Keyboard Applied to Eye Movement Control System
authors: Tang, L. and Chen, Y. and Huang, Z. and Chen, Q.
venue: Applied Human Factors and Ergonomics International
summary_en: Three gaze-controlled Chinese keyboard layouts are compared through daily-sentence entry with dwell selection and permitted corrections.
summary_zh: 通过允许纠错的日常句子输入任务，比较三种采用停留选择的眼控中文键盘布局。
summary_ja: 注視選択と修正を許可した日常文入力により、3種類の視線操作中国語キーボード配列を比較する。
summary_ko: 응시 선택과 교정을 허용한 일상 문장 입력으로 세 가지 시선 제어 중국어 키보드 배열을 비교한다.

title: A P300 Character Correction Algorithm Based on Hidden Markov Model
authors: Gao, Ruochen and Ke, Jingshuang and Chen, Qingzhi and Huang, Zhihua
venue: 2024 7th Asia Conference on Cognitive Engineering and Intelligent lnteraction (CEII)
summary_en: A hidden Markov model corrects Pinyin-symbol sequences from a P300 speller; final Han-candidate confirmation is not shown.
summary_zh: 隐马尔可夫模型纠正 P300 拼写器产生的拼音符号序列，未展示最终汉字候选确认。
summary_ja: 隠れマルコフモデルでP300スペラーの拼音記号列を修正する。最終漢字候補の確定は示さない。
summary_ko: 은닉 마르코프 모델로 P300 스펠러의 병음 기호열을 교정한다. 최종 한자 후보 확정은 제시하지 않는다.

title: Segmentation and Recognition of Aerial Handwritten Hiragana
authors: Hosono, Kotaro and Ito, Shin-Ici and Ito, Momoyo and Fukumi, Minoru
venue: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Cybernetics Technology & Applications (ICICyTA)
summary_en: Aerial hiragana trajectories are segmented and recognized into strings, evaluated on fixed syllabary sequences.
summary_zh: 将空中平假名轨迹分割并识别为字符串，以固定音节表序列进行评估。
summary_ja: 空中のひらがな軌跡を分割して文字列として認識し、固定された五十音列で評価する。
summary_ko: 공중 히라가나 궤적을 분할하여 문자열로 인식하고 고정된 오십음도 순서로 평가한다.

title: Eye Strokes: An Eye-gaze Drawing System for Mandarin Characters
authors: Tong, D. C. W.
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques
summary_en: Eye movements draw strokes for a limited Mandarin character set; the tested single characters include 一, 十 and 床.
summary_zh: 通过眼动绘制有限字集中的汉字笔画，测试的单字包括“一”“十”和“床”。
summary_ja: 眼球運動で限定された中国語文字集合の筆画を描く。単字実験には一・十・床が含まれる。
summary_ko: 눈 움직임으로 제한된 중국어 문자 집합의 획을 그린다. 단일 문자 실험에는 一·十·床이 포함된다.

title: Reconstructing multi-stroke characters from brain signals toward generalizable handwriting brain–computer interfaces
authors: Yang, Xiaomeng and Xiong, Xinzhu and Li, Xufei and Lian, Qi and Zhu, Junming and Zhang, Jianmin and Qi, Yu and Wang, Yueming
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
summary_en: Brain signals reconstruct imagined Chinese handwriting trajectories using externally supplied stroke transitions, followed by template and language-model decoding.
summary_zh: 脑信号结合外部提供的笔画转换时点重建想象的汉字手写轨迹，随后使用模板与语言模型解码。
summary_ja: 外部から与えた筆画遷移を使い、脳信号から想像した中国語手書き軌跡を再構成して、テンプレートと言語モデルで復号する。
summary_ko: 외부에서 주어진 획 전환을 사용하여 뇌 신호로 상상한 중국어 필기 궤적을 재구성하고 템플릿과 언어 모델로 디코딩한다.

title: Mind-Pinyin Speller: A Non-Invasive Brain-Computer Interface for Efficient Chinese Character Input Using EEG-Based Imagined Handwriting
authors: Wu, Lingyu and Jung, Tzyy-Ping and Li, Xiaojian and Zhou, Yanhong and Wan, Xianglong and Jiao, Wenlong and Xie, Xueguang and Duan, Dingna and Liu, Tiange and Yu, Hao and Li, Danyang and Li, Xiaoling and Wu, Zhenzhen and Wang, Jing and Song, Haiqing and Wen, Dong
venue: Expert Systems with Applications
summary_en: Imagined handwriting is classified into isolated Pinyin components; homophone choice and final Han-character composition are not evaluated.
summary_zh: 将想象手写分类为独立拼音组件，未评估同音字选择及最终汉字组合。
summary_ja: 想像した手書きを個別の拼音構成要素へ分類する。同音字の選択と最終漢字の合成は評価しない。
summary_ko: 상상한 필기를 개별 병음 구성 요소로 분류한다. 동음자 선택과 최종 한자 조합은 평가하지 않는다.

title: A Cheonjiin Layout Mental Speller: Developing a Simple and Cost-Effective EEG-Based Brain–Computer Interface System
authors: Ahn, J. W. and Yu, G. Y. and Kim, S. W. and Seok, Y. S. and Byun, K. M. and Choi, S. H.
venue: Sensors
summary_en: EEG signals select five cursor commands on a Cheonjiin keyboard to compose Hangul; command accuracy is distinct from text-entry accuracy.
summary_zh: 脑电信号选择 Cheonjiin 键盘上的五种光标命令以组合 Hangul；命令准确率与文字输入准确率不同。
summary_ja: EEGで5種類のカーソル命令を選び、CheonjiinキーボードでHangulを合成する。命令精度と文字入力精度を区別する。
summary_ko: EEG로 다섯 가지 커서 명령을 선택하여 천지인 키보드에서 한글을 조합한다. 명령 정확도와 문자 입력 정확도를 구분한다.

title: An asynchronous Chinese speller integrating eye tracking and large language models into a reactive BCI
authors: Li, Hao and Yu, Yang and Zhang, Yifan and Chen, Xin and Zhou, Liang and Liu, Jinfang and Zhang, Ming and Zeng, Ling-Li and Hu, Dewen
venue: Science China Information Sciences
summary_en: Gaze and P300 signals support initial, final and Han-character selection, supplemented by contextual predictions from a language model.
summary_zh: 眼动与 P300 信号支持声母、韵母和汉字选择，并由语言模型提供上下文预测。
summary_ja: 視線とP300で声母・韻母・漢字を選び、言語モデルの文脈予測で補う。
summary_ko: 시선과 P300으로 성모·운모·한자를 선택하고 언어 모델의 문맥 예측으로 보완한다.

title: An EEG dataset for handwriting imagery decoding of Chinese character strokes and Pinyin single vowels
authors: Wang, Fan and Chen, Yanxiao and Wang, Peng and Gong, Anmin and Xu, Jiaping and Fu, Yunfa
venue: Scientific Data
summary_en: The dataset records imagined Chinese strokes and Pinyin vowels. It does not demonstrate complete character composition or online spelling.
summary_zh: 数据集记录想象中的汉字笔画及拼音元音，未展示完整汉字组合或在线拼写。
summary_ja: 想像した中国語の筆画と拼音母音を記録したデータセットである。文字全体の合成やオンライン入力は実証しない。
summary_ko: 상상한 중국어 획과 병음 모음을 기록한 데이터셋이다. 완전한 문자 조합이나 온라인 입력은 입증하지 않는다.

title: A Japanese input method using leap motion in virtual reality
authors: Komiya, Kosuke and Nakajima, Tatsuo
venue: 2017 Tenth International Conference on Mobile Computing and Ubiquitous Network (ICMU)
summary_en: Finger flexion and extension select Japanese consonants and vowels in VR, producing kana with a separate deletion gesture.
summary_zh: 在 VR 中，通过手指屈伸选择日语辅音与元音以生成假名，并以独立手势删除。
summary_ja: VRで指の屈曲と伸展により子音と母音を選んで仮名を作り、別のジェスチャーで削除する。
summary_ko: VR에서 손가락 굽힘과 폄으로 자음과 모음을 선택해 가나를 만들고 별도 제스처로 삭제한다.

title: Space saving text input method for head mounted display with virtual 12-key keyboard
authors: Ogitani, Taihei and Arahori, Yoshitaka and Shinyama, Yusuke and Gondow, Katsuhiko
venue: 2018 IEEE 32nd International Conference on Advanced Information Networking and Applications (AINA)
summary_en: A virtual twelve-key keyboard supports Japanese kana and English entry through mid-air or palm-based flick gestures.
summary_zh: 虚拟十二键键盘通过空中或掌上滑动手势，支持日文假名和英文输入。
summary_ja: 仮想12キーを空中または手のひら上のフリックで操作し、日本語の仮名と英語を入力する。
summary_ko: 가상 12키를 공중 또는 손바닥 위 플릭으로 조작하여 일본어 가나와 영어를 입력한다.

title: Interaction with three-dimensional gesture and character input in virtual reality: recognizing gestures in different directions and improving user input
authors: Yang, J. and Wang, Y. and Lv, Z. and Jiang, N. and others
venue: IEEE Consumer …
summary_en: Gesture recognition separates writing from repositioning; projected three-dimensional trajectories are passed to a Chinese handwriting recognizer.
summary_zh: 手势识别区分书写与重新定位，再将三维轨迹投影后交由中文手写识别器处理。
summary_ja: ジェスチャー認識で筆記と移動を分け、投影した3次元軌跡を中国語手書き認識器へ渡す。
summary_ko: 제스처 인식으로 필기와 위치 이동을 구분하고 투영된 3차원 궤적을 중국어 필기 인식기에 전달한다.

title: Hover-Based Japanese Input Method without Restricting Arm Position for XR
authors: Kato, Shingo and Shizuki, Buntarou
venue: Proceedings of the 35th Australian Computer-Human Interaction Conference
summary_en: A wrist camera detects hovering fingertips for dwell-based kana selection while allowing the arm to remain lowered.
summary_zh: 腕部摄像头检测悬停指尖，以停留方式选择假名，并允许手臂保持低位。
summary_ja: 手首カメラで空中の指先を検出し、腕を下げたまま滞留操作で仮名を選ぶ。
summary_ko: 손목 카메라로 떠 있는 손끝을 감지하여 팔을 내린 상태에서 머무르기로 가나를 선택한다.

title: Research for Japanese Input Method using Flick in Virtual Reality
authors: Monobe, Kantaro and Ohishi, Masaki
venue: 2025 4th Asia Conference on Algorithms, Computing and Machine Learning (CACML)
summary_en: Touch, pinch and flick actions operate a Japanese kana keyboard in VR, with modifiers and deletion controls.
summary_zh: 触碰、捏合及滑动操作 VR 日文假名键盘，并支持修饰符和删除。
summary_ja: VR仮名キーボードをタッチ・ピンチ・フリックで操作し、修飾と削除も行う。
summary_ko: 터치·핀치·플릭으로 VR 가나 키보드를 조작하며 수정 기호와 삭제를 지원한다.

title: FlickPose: A Hand Tracking-Based Text Input System for Mobile Users Wearing Smart Glasses
authors: Yuasa, Ryo and Nagao, Katashi
venue: Applied Sciences
summary_en: One hand selects a key and the other selects a symbol through hand poses; dictionary-based kana–Kanji conversion produces Japanese text.
summary_zh: 一只手选键，另一只手通过手势选字符，再由基于词典的假名转汉字生成日文文本。
summary_ja: 片手でキー、もう片手の姿勢で記号を選ぶ。辞書による仮名漢字変換で日本語の文字列を作る。
summary_ko: 한 손으로 키를 고르고 다른 손 자세로 문자를 선택한다. 사전 기반 가나–한자 변환으로 일본어 텍스트를 만든다.

title: A new statistical approach to Chinese Pinyin input
authors: Chen, Zheng and Lee, Kai-Fu
venue: Proceedings of the 38th Annual Meeting on Association for Computational Linguistics - ACL '00
summary_en: Statistical Pinyin-to-Chinese conversion combines a language model with spelling tolerance and modeless English entry.
summary_zh: 统计拼音转汉字结合语言模型、拼写容错及无模式切换的英文输入。
summary_ja: 統計的な拼音漢字変換に言語モデル、綴り誤りの許容、モード切替不要の英語入力を組み合わせる。
summary_ko: 통계적 병음–한자 변환에 언어 모델, 철자 오류 허용, 모드 전환 없는 영어 입력을 결합한다.

title: Chinese input with keyboard and eye-tracking: an anatomical study
authors: Wang, Jingtao and Zhai, Shumin and Su, Hui
venue: Proceedings of the SIGCHI conference on Human …
summary_en: Keyboard and eye-tracking methods are compared for Chinese candidate selection in a single-character dictation task.
summary_zh: 通过单字听写任务，比较键盘和眼动两种汉字候选选择方式。
summary_ja: 単一漢字の書き取りで、キーボードと視線による中国語候補選択を比較する。
summary_ko: 한자 한 글자 받아쓰기에서 키보드와 시선 기반 중국어 후보 선택을 비교한다.

title: An approach to machine learning of Chinese Pinyin-to-character conversion for small-memory application
authors: Liu, B. Q. and Wang, X. L.
venue: Proceedings. International Conference on Machine Learning and Cybernetics
summary_en: A small-memory Pinyin converter learns real and artificial word entries to improve tonal Pinyin-to-character conversion.
summary_zh: 小内存拼音转换器学习真实词与构造词条，以改进带声调拼音转汉字。
summary_ja: 小容量の拼音変換器が実単語と人工的な語を学習し、声調付き拼音から漢字への変換を改善する。
summary_ko: 소용량 병음 변환기가 실제 단어와 인공 단어 항목을 학습하여 성조 병음–한자 변환을 개선한다.

title: Cross platform CJK input method engine
authors: Lo, C. W. and Lu, Q. and Ng, K. T.
venue: IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man and Cybernetics
summary_en: A cross-platform engine demonstrates Cangjie and simplified shape-code input, with prefix hints, numbered candidates and browser glyph images.
summary_zh: 跨平台引擎演示仓颉及简易形码输入，提供前缀提示、数字候选选择和浏览器字形图片。
summary_ja: クロスプラットフォームのエンジンが倉頡と簡略形状コード入力を示す。接頭部のヒント、番号付き候補、ブラウザーの字形画像を備える。
summary_ko: 크로스 플랫폼 엔진으로 창힐과 간소화 형태 코드 입력을 제시한다. 접두 힌트, 번호 후보, 브라우저 글리프 이미지를 제공한다.

title: QuickStroke: an incremental on-line Chinese handwriting recognition system
authors: Matic, N.P. and Platt, J.C. and Wang, T.
venue: Object recognition supported by user interaction for service robots
summary_en: Chinese handwriting candidates update after each additional stroke, allowing selection before the character is fully written.
summary_zh: 每增加一笔便更新汉字手写候选，用户可在写完全部笔画前选择目标字。
summary_ja: 筆画を加えるたびに中国語手書き候補を更新し、文字を最後まで書く前に選択できる。
summary_ko: 획을 추가할 때마다 중국어 필기 후보를 갱신하여 글자를 완성하기 전에 선택할 수 있다.

title: Adaptive compression-based approach for Chinese pinyin input
authors: Huang, Jin Hu and Powers, David
venue: … of the Third SIGHAN Workshop on …
summary_en: Compression-based statistical modeling adapts Pinyin-to-Chinese conversion across news and story text, assuming one pronunciation per character.
summary_zh: 基于压缩的统计建模使拼音转汉字适应新闻和故事文本，模型假定每字仅有一种读音。
summary_ja: 圧縮に基づく統計モデルがニュースと物語の拼音漢字変換に適応する。1文字につき1つの読みを仮定する。
summary_ko: 압축 기반 통계 모델이 뉴스와 이야기의 병음–한자 변환에 적응하며 글자당 하나의 발음을 가정한다.

title: Mining Pinyin-to-character conversion rules from large-scale corpus: a rough set approach
authors: Xiaolong, W. and Qingcai, C. and Yeung, D.S.
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man and Cybernetics, Part B (Cybernetics)
summary_en: Rough-set rules learned from corpus contexts convert segmented toneless Pinyin into Chinese, allowing unresolved cases to remain undecided.
summary_zh: 由语料上下文学习粗糙集规则，将已分音节的无调拼音转换为汉字，并允许对未解决的情况保留判断。
summary_ja: コーパス文脈から学習したラフ集合規則で、分割済みの声調なし拼音を漢字へ変換する。解決できない場合は保留できる。
summary_ko: 코퍼스 문맥에서 학습한 러프 집합 규칙으로 분할된 무성조 병음을 한자로 변환하며 미해결 사례는 보류한다.

title: Online Chinese character recognition system with handwritten Pinyin input
authors: Ge, Y. and Guo, F. J. and Zhen, L. X. and Chen, Q. S.
venue: Eighth International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR'05)
summary_en: A handwriting interface accepts Chinese characters or Pinyin syllables; recognized Pinyin opens a frequency-ranked Han-candidate list.
summary_zh: 手写界面接受汉字或拼音音节，识别出的拼音用于打开按频率排列的汉字候选列表。
summary_ja: 手書きで漢字または拼音音節を受け付け、拼音と認識すると頻度順の漢字候補を開く。
summary_ko: 한자나 병음 음절의 필기를 받아들이며 병음으로 인식되면 빈도순 한자 후보 목록을 연다.

title: Graphics matter: a case study of mobile phone keypad design for chinese input
authors: Lin, Min and Sears, Andrew
venue: CHI '05 Extended Abstracts on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: Graphical keypad labels are compared for stroke-based Chinese entry, using both mobile typing and stroke-to-key mapping tasks.
summary_zh: 通过手机输入及笔画到按键映射任务，比较中文笔画输入键盘上的图形标签。
summary_ja: 中国語の筆画入力に使う図形的なキーラベルを、携帯入力と筆画・キー対応課題で比較する。
summary_ko: 모바일 입력과 획–키 대응 과제로 중국어 획 입력용 그래픽 키 라벨을 비교한다.

title: Applying a Mix Word-Pair Identifier to the Chinese Syllable-to-Word Conversion Problem
authors: Tsai, J. L.
venue: Ijcnlp 2005 2nd International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing Companion Volume to the Proceedings of Conference Including Posters Demos and Tutorial Abstracts
summary_en: A mix word-pair identifier resolves phonetic and segmentation ambiguities by replacing selected words in converted Chinese sentences.
summary_zh: 混合词对识别器通过替换已转换中文句子中的选定词语，消解读音及分词歧义。
summary_ja: 混合単語対の識別器で変換済み中国語文の一部の語を置換し、音韻と分割の曖昧性を解く。
summary_ko: 혼합 단어쌍 식별기로 변환된 중국어 문장의 일부 단어를 대체하여 발음 및 분할의 모호성을 해소한다.

title: Using word-pair identifier to improve Chinese input system
authors: Tsai, J. L.
venue: Sighan@ijcnlp 2005 4th Sighan Workshop on Chinese Language Processing Proceedings of the Workshop
summary_en: Word-pair co-occurrence helps disambiguate tonal or toneless syllables during traditional Chinese input.
summary_zh: 词对共现信息用于消解繁体中文输入中带调或无调音节的歧义。
summary_ja: 単語対の共起を使い、繁体字入力で声調付き・声調なし音節の曖昧性を解く。
summary_ko: 단어쌍 공기를 활용하여 번체 한자 입력에서 성조 유무에 따른 음절의 모호성을 해소한다.

title: Spoken correction for chinese text entry
authors: Hsu, Bo-June Paul and Glass, James
venue: Chinese Spoken Language Processing
summary_en: Spoken character descriptions constrain recognition to correct Zhuyin-based Chinese input, either replacing text or narrowing candidates.
summary_zh: 口述汉字描述约束识别范围，用于修正基于注音的中文输入，可直接替换文字或缩小候选范围。
summary_ja: 文字の説明を発話して認識を制約し、注音による中国語入力を置換または候補の絞り込みで修正する。
summary_ko: 글자 설명을 발화하여 인식을 제약하고 텍스트 대체나 후보 축소로 주음 기반 중국어 입력을 교정한다.

title: Application of Quotient Space Granularity Computation Theory in Pinyin-Chinese Character Conversion
authors: Liu, Zheng-yi and Gong, Jian-cheng and Wu, Jian-guo
venue: 2006 International Conference on Machine Learning and Cybernetics
summary_en: A coarsened Pinyin candidate lattice is decoded with lexical models, then refined using grammar and semantic information.
summary_zh: 先简化拼音候选词格并以词汇模型解码，再利用语法及语义信息细化结果。
summary_ja: 粗くまとめた拼音候補格子を語彙モデルで復号し、文法と意味情報で精密化する。
summary_ko: 거칠게 축약한 병음 후보 격자를 어휘 모델로 디코딩한 뒤 문법과 의미 정보로 정교화한다.

title: Using word support model to improve Chinese input system
authors: Tsai, J. L.
venue: Coling Acl 2006 21st International Conference on Computational Linguistics and 44th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics Proceedings of the Main Conference Poster Sessions
summary_en: Support scores from matching multisyllabic word pairs rank replacements to resolve Chinese syllable-to-word ambiguity.
summary_zh: 根据匹配的多音节词对计算支持度，对替换词排序，以消解中文音节转词歧义。
summary_ja: 一致する複数音節の単語対から支持得点を計算し、置換候補を順位付けして中国語の音節・単語曖昧性を解く。
summary_ko: 일치하는 다음절 단어쌍의 지지 점수로 대체 후보 순위를 매겨 중국어 음절–단어 모호성을 해소한다.

title: Chinese input method based on reduced Mandarin phonetic alphabet
authors: Tseng, C. H.
venue: Proceedings of the Annual Conference of the International Speech Communication Association Interspeech
summary_en: Reduced first-symbol phonetic input is assessed through language-model uncertainty; decoded Chinese entry is not directly evaluated.
summary_zh: 通过语言模型的不确定性评估首符号简化注音输入，未直接评估解码后的中文输入。
summary_ja: 先頭音韻記号だけを使う縮約入力を言語モデルの不確実性で評価する。復号した漢字入力は直接評価しない。
summary_ko: 첫 음성 기호만 사용하는 축약 입력을 언어 모델의 불확실성으로 평가한다. 디코딩된 한자 입력은 직접 평가하지 않는다.

title: A maximum entropy approach to Chinese Pin Yin-To-character conversion
authors: Wang, Xuan and Lu Li and Yao, Lin and Anwar, Waqas
venue: 2006 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man and Cybernetics
summary_en: Maximum-entropy modeling converts toneless Pinyin character by character using local and longer-distance phonetic context.
summary_zh: 最大熵模型结合局部及较远距离的读音上下文，将无调拼音逐字转换为汉字。
summary_ja: 最大エントロピーモデルが近傍と遠方の音韻文脈を使い、声調なし拼音を1文字ずつ漢字へ変換する。
summary_ko: 최대 엔트로피 모델이 근거리와 장거리 발음 문맥을 사용하여 무성조 병음을 한 글자씩 한자로 변환한다.

title: Improved Chinese character input by merging speech and handwriting recognition hypotheses
authors: Zhou, X. and Tian, Y. and Zhou, J. and Soong, F. K. and others
venue: 2006 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics Speed and Signal Processing Proceedings
summary_en: Speech hypotheses and incremental handwritten strokes jointly rerank Chinese character candidates after each stroke.
summary_zh: 语音假设与逐步增加的手写笔画共同作用，每写一笔便重新排列汉字候选。
summary_ja: 音声仮説と逐次追加する手書き筆画を併用し、各筆画の後に中国語文字候補を並べ替える。
summary_ko: 음성 가설과 순차적으로 추가한 필기 획을 함께 사용하여 매 획 뒤 중국어 문자 후보 순위를 조정한다.

title: Constructing Chinese characters: keypad design for mobile phones
authors: Lin, Min and Sears, Andrew
venue: Behaviour & Information Technology
summary_en: A simulated stroke keypad tests Chinese character construction; predictive candidates are analyzed retrospectively rather than selected interactively.
summary_zh: 模拟笔画键盘用于测试汉字构造，预测候选在事后分析，并非交互选择。
summary_ja: 模擬筆画キーパッドで漢字の構成を試す。予測候補は対話的に選ばず、事後に分析する。
summary_ko: 모의 획 키패드로 한자 구성을 시험한다. 예측 후보는 대화형으로 선택하지 않고 사후 분석한다.

title: Chinese pinyin phrasal input on mobile phone: usability and developing trends
authors: Liu, Ying and Wang, Qiqun
venue: Proceedings of the 4th international conference on …
summary_en: Mobile Pinyin phrase entry compares direct Chinese candidate selection with an explicit Pinyin-disambiguation stage.
summary_zh: 手机拼音词组输入比较直接选择汉字候选与先明确消解拼音歧义的方式。
summary_ja: 携帯の拼音句入力で、直接の漢字候補選択と、明示的な拼音曖昧性解消段階を比較する。
summary_ko: 모바일 병음 구 입력에서 직접 한자 후보 선택과 명시적인 병음 모호성 해소 단계를 비교한다.

title: On-line recognition of handwritten Renqun shorthand for fast mobile Chinese text entry
authors: Ma, Yang and Leedham, Graham
venue: Pattern Recognition Letters
summary_en: Handwritten shorthand is recognized into consonant and rhyme interpretations; conversion through Pinyin into Han text remains future work.
summary_zh: 手写速记识别产生声母及韵母解释，经拼音转换为汉字仍属于后续工作。
summary_ja: 手書き速記を声母・韻母の解釈へ認識する。拼音を介する漢字変換は今後の課題である。
summary_ko: 필기 속기를 성모·운모 해석으로 인식한다. 병음을 거쳐 한자로 변환하는 과정은 향후 과제이다.

title: Key reduction of a Chinese phonetic input method by minimizing message ambiguity
authors: Tung, C.
venue: Computer Standards and Interfaces
summary_en: Zhuyin symbols are mapped to reduced key sets to balance key count and ambiguity in traditional Chinese selection.
summary_zh: 将注音符号映射至精简键集，在繁体汉字选择中平衡按键数量与编码歧义。
summary_ja: 注音記号を少数のキーへ割り当て、繁体字選択のキー数と曖昧性のバランスを取る。
summary_ko: 주음 기호를 적은 수의 키에 배정하여 번체 한자 선택의 키 수와 모호성 간 균형을 맞춘다.

title: Exploiting pinyin constraints in pinyin-to-character conversion task: a class-based maximum entropy markov model approach
authors: Xiao, Jinghui and Liu, Bingquan and Wang, Xiaolong
venue: Computational Linguistics and Chinese Language Processing
