summary_en: Pinyin context predicts word classes that are combined with transition and emission scores for Chinese sequence decoding.
summary_zh: 利用拼音上下文预测词类，再结合转移及发射分数进行中文序列解码。
summary_ja: 拼音文脈で品詞を予測し、遷移と出力の得点と組み合わせて中国語文字列を復号する。
summary_ko: 병음 문맥으로 품사를 예측하고 전이·방출 점수와 결합하여 중국어 시퀀스를 디코딩한다.

title: A segment-based hidden markov model for real-setting pinyin-to-chinese conversion
authors: Zhou, Xiaohua and Hu, Xiaohua and Zhang, Xiaodan and Shen, Xiajiong
venue: Proceedings of the sixteenth ACM conference on Conference on information and knowledge management
summary_en: A segment-based hidden Markov model converts continuous Pinyin into Chinese using lexical and cross-word character probabilities.
summary_zh: 基于片段的隐马尔可夫模型结合词汇及跨词字符概率，将连续拼音转换为中文。
summary_ja: 区間単位の隠れマルコフモデルが語彙確率と語をまたぐ文字確率を使い、連続拼音を漢字へ変換する。
summary_ko: 구간 기반 은닉 마르코프 모델이 어휘 확률과 단어 간 문자 확률을 사용하여 연속 병음을 한자로 변환한다.

title: Multimodal Chinese text entry with speech and keypad on mobile devices
authors: Jiang, Yingying and Wang, Xugang and Tian, Feng and Ao, Xiang and Dai, Guozhong and Wang, Hongan
venue: Proceedings of the 13th international conference on Intelligent user interfaces
summary_en: Speech, keypad initials and word frequency are fused to generate Chinese candidates that the user confirms.
summary_zh: 融合语音、键盘声母和词频，生成由用户确认的中文候选。
summary_ja: 音声・キーパッドの頭文字・単語頻度を融合し、利用者が確定する中国語候補を生成する。
summary_ko: 음성·키패드 첫 글자·단어 빈도를 융합하여 사용자가 확정할 중국어 후보를 생성한다.

title: A novel statistical chinese language model and its application in pinyin-to-character conversion
authors: Lin, Bo and Zhang, Jun
venue: Proceedings of the 17th ACM conference on Information and knowledge management
summary_en: A word-distance language model converts Pinyin and supports locating and replacing an erroneous candidate with an additional key action.
summary_zh: 词距语言模型用于拼音转换，并支持以额外按键定位和替换错误候选。
summary_ja: 単語距離モデルで拼音を変換し、追加キー操作で誤った候補の位置を指定して置換する。
summary_ko: 단어 거리 모델로 병음을 변환하고 추가 키 조작으로 잘못된 후보의 위치를 찾아 대체한다.

title: RotaTxt: Chinese pinyin input with a rotator
authors: Liu, Ying and Räihä, Kari-Jouko
venue: Proceedings of the 10th international conference on Human computer interaction with mobile devices and services
summary_en: A rotator selects Pinyin letters or consonant–final pairs and then Chinese candidates, comparing alphabetic and phonetic ordering.
summary_zh: 旋钮先选择拼音字母或声韵母组合，再选择汉字候选，研究比较字母序与语音序排列。
summary_ja: 回転装置で拼音字母または声母・韻母の対を選び、続いて漢字候補を選ぶ。字母順と音韻順を比較する。
summary_ko: 회전 장치로 병음 글자나 성모–운모 쌍을 선택한 뒤 한자 후보를 고르며 알파벳순과 음성순 배열을 비교한다.

title: Ambiguity solution of pinyin segmentation in continuous pinyin-to-character conversion
authors: Wen, Juan and Wang, Xiaojie and Xu, Wenzhi and Jiang, Huixing
venue: 2008 International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Engineering
summary_en: Matching rules and language-model scores resolve continuous Pinyin syllable boundaries before conversion to Chinese words.
summary_zh: 通过匹配规则和语言模型分数消解连续拼音的音节边界，再转换为中文词语。
summary_ja: 照合規則と言語モデル得点で連続拼音の音節境界を決めてから、中国語単語へ変換する。
summary_ko: 매칭 규칙과 언어 모델 점수로 연속 병음의 음절 경계를 정한 뒤 중국어 단어로 변환한다.

title: The Design of Input Method for CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B
authors: Gong, Zheng and Zhang, Rui
venue: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
summary_en: Unicode Extension B characters are retrieved through stroke sequences or radical-and-shape codes.
summary_zh: 通过笔画序列或部首与字形组合编码，检索 Unicode 扩展 B 区汉字。
summary_ja: 筆画列または部首・形状コードからUnicode拡張Bの漢字を検索する。
summary_ko: 획 시퀀스나 부수·형태 코드로 유니코드 확장 B 한자를 검색한다.

title: An artificial immune network approach for pinyin-to-character conversion
authors: Jiang, W. and Pang, X. L.
venue: 2009 IEEE International Conference on Virtual Environments, Human-Computer Interfaces and Measurements Systems
summary_en: An artificial immune network scores Pinyin-to-Chinese word lattices, combining sequence decoding with error-driven updates.
summary_zh: 人工免疫网络对拼音转汉字词格评分，结合序列解码与错误驱动更新。
summary_ja: 人工免疫ネットワークが拼音漢字の単語格子を採点し、系列復号と誤りに基づく更新を組み合わせる。
summary_ko: 인공 면역 네트워크가 병음–한자 단어 격자에 점수를 부여하고 시퀀스 디코딩과 오류 기반 갱신을 결합한다.

title: Effect of the number of candidate characters on the performance of Chinese characters input
authors: Li, Hongting and Sang, Songling and Wang, Zhe and Ge, Liezhong
venue: 2009 Second International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
summary_en: The number of displayed Chinese candidates is varied during single-character full-Pinyin input, with target readings supplied.
summary_zh: 在提供目标读音的单字全拼输入中，改变显示的汉字候选数量。
summary_ja: 読みを提示した単字の全拼音入力で、表示する漢字候補数を変えて比較する。
summary_ko: 목표 발음을 제공한 단일 글자 전체 병음 입력에서 표시되는 한자 후보 수를 바꾸어 비교한다.

title: Chinese pinyin-text conversion on segmented text
authors: Liu, Wei and Guthrie, Louise
venue: Text, Speech and Dialogue
summary_en: Pinyin generated from already segmented text is converted back to Chinese with word boundaries supplied.
summary_zh: 将已分词文本生成的拼音转换回汉字，转换时提供已知词界。
summary_ja: 分割済みの文章から生成した拼音を、単語境界を与えた状態で中国語に戻す。
summary_ko: 분할된 텍스트에서 생성한 병음을 단어 경계가 주어진 상태에서 중국어로 되돌린다.

title: Immediate user performances with touch Chinese text entry solutions on handheld devices
authors: Liu, Ying and Ding, Kai and Liu, Ning
venue: Proceedings of the 11th International Conference on Human-Computer Interaction with Mobile Devices and Services
summary_en: Four handheld touchscreen methods are compared during Chinese short-message copying.
summary_zh: 通过中文短消息抄录任务，比较四种手持触屏输入方式。
summary_ja: 中国語の短いメッセージを写す課題で、4種類の携帯タッチ入力方式を比較する。
summary_ko: 중국어 짧은 메시지 전사 과제로 네 가지 휴대용 터치 입력 방식을 비교한다.

title: Six-digit stroke-based Chinese input method
authors: Po, Lai-Man and Wong, Chi-Kwan and Au, Yiu-Ki and Ng, Ka-Ho and Wong, Ka-Man
venue: 2009 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man and Cybernetics
summary_en: Six-digit codes use the first three and last three strokes of a character, with phrase codes, wildcards and candidate pages.
summary_zh: 六位编码使用汉字的前三笔及末三笔，并支持词组编码、通配符及候选翻页。
summary_ja: 最初の3画と最後の3画から6桁コードを作り、句コード・ワイルドカード・候補ページを備える。
summary_ko: 처음 세 획과 마지막 세 획으로 6자리 코드를 만들며 구 코드·와일드카드·후보 페이지를 지원한다.

title: The optimal size of handwriting character input boxes on PDAs
authors: Ren, Xiangshi and Zhou, Xiaolei
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction
summary_en: Input-box sizes are compared for handwritten Japanese and alphanumeric characters; recognition is performed afterward rather than during entry.
summary_zh: 比较日文及字母数字手写的输入框尺寸，识别在输入结束后进行，而非实时执行。
summary_ja: 日本語と英数字の手書きで入力枠の大きさを比較する。認識は入力中でなく入力後に行う。
summary_ko: 일본어와 영숫자 필기에서 입력 상자 크기를 비교한다. 인식은 입력 중이 아니라 입력 후에 수행한다.

title: A modified phoneme-based Chinese input method for minimizing conflict code rate
authors: Tung, C. H.
venue: Computer Standards and Interfaces
summary_en: Phonetic features of characters and selected radicals form hybrid codes intended to reduce collisions in Chinese input.
summary_zh: 组合汉字及选定部首的语音特征，形成旨在减少中文输入重码的混合编码。
summary_ja: 文字と一部の部首の音韻特徴を組み合わせ、中国語入力のコード衝突を減らす混合コードを作る。
summary_ko: 글자와 일부 부수의 음성 특징을 결합하여 중국어 입력의 코드 충돌을 줄이려는 혼합 코드를 만든다.

title: Applying the word acquiring algorithm to the pinyin-to-character conversion
authors: Wei, Jiang and Li, Pang Xiu
venue: 2009 Fifth International Conference on Natural Computation
summary_en: Activity and correlation scores guide Chinese word-lattice decoding, while feedback updates correct and erroneous paths.
summary_zh: 利用活动度及相关性分数指导中文词格解码，并通过反馈更新正确与错误路径。
summary_ja: 活動度と相関の得点で中国語の単語格子を復号し、フィードバックで正誤の経路を更新する。
summary_ko: 활성도와 상관 점수로 중국어 단어 격자를 디코딩하고 피드백으로 올바른 경로와 오류 경로를 갱신한다.

title: Linux and minigui oriented chinese input method editor's research and practice
authors: Wei, Zheng and Wu, Junsheng and Lu, Xiazi and Zhang, Shuming
venue: 2009 International Conference on Future Networks
summary_en: A Linux/MiniGUI engine maps indexed codes to Chinese characters and phrases across Pinyin, shape and stroke schemes.
summary_zh: Linux/MiniGUI 引擎通过索引编码映射汉字及词组，支持拼音、形码和笔画等方案。
summary_ja: Linux/MiniGUIエンジンが拼音・形状・筆画方式の索引コードを中国語の文字や句に対応させる。
summary_ko: Linux/MiniGUI 엔진이 병음·형태·획 방식의 색인 코드를 중국어 문자와 구에 대응시킨다.

title: The birth of mobile chinese keypad & hybrid input methods
authors: Yan, Q.
venue: CHI'09 Extended Abstracts on Human Factors in …
summary_en: A mobile radical keypad combines spatial grouping, stroke fallback and frequency-ranked Chinese candidates.
summary_zh: 手机部件键盘结合空间分组、笔画后备输入及按频率排列的汉字候选。
summary_ja: 携帯用部首キーパッドが空間的なグループ分け、筆画入力への切替、頻度順の漢字候補を組み合わせる。
summary_ko: 모바일 부수 키패드가 공간적 그룹화, 획 입력 대안, 빈도순 한자 후보를 결합한다.

title: The prompting method of IPTV input method for Chinese with full text search technology
authors: Li, Xiaofeng and Sun, Feifei and Xie, Liguo and Sun, Mingsong
venue: 2010 Seventh International Conference on Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery
summary_en: Numeric remote-control input retrieves Chinese television-search terms using field-specific dictionaries and full-text search.
summary_zh: 数字遥控输入结合字段专用词典与全文检索，获取中文电视搜索词。
summary_ja: 数字リモコンから分野別辞書と全文検索を使い、中国語のテレビ検索語を取り出す。
summary_ko: 숫자 리모컨에서 분야별 사전과 전문 검색으로 중국어 TV 검색어를 찾는다.

title: Predicting Chinese text entry speeds on mobile phones
authors: Liu, Ying and Räihä, Kari Jouko
venue: Proceedings of the SIGCHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: A model estimates mobile Pinyin entry time using thumb movement and candidate navigation, with prediction enabled or disabled.
summary_zh: 模型结合拇指移动及候选导航，估计开启或关闭预测时的手机拼音输入时间。
summary_ja: 親指の移動と候補操作から携帯拼音入力時間を推定し、予測機能の有無を扱う。
summary_ko: 엄지 이동과 후보 탐색으로 모바일 병음 입력 시간을 추정하며 예측 기능의 활성·비활성 조건을 다룬다.

title: Stroke++: A hybrid chinese input method for touch screen mobile phones
authors: Niu, Jianwei and Zhu, Like and Yan, Qifeng and Liu, Yingfei and Wang, Kongqiao
venue: Proceedings of the 12th international conference on Human computer interaction with mobile devices and services
summary_en: A touchscreen method combines radicals and strokes, allowing unordered components and Chinese character or phrase selection.
summary_zh: 触屏输入法结合部件与笔画，允许无序部件输入，并支持汉字或词组选择。
summary_ja: タッチ入力で部首と筆画を組み合わせ、構成要素の順序を問わず漢字や句を選択できる。
summary_ko: 터치 입력에서 부수와 획을 결합하여 구성 요소 순서와 무관하게 한자나 구를 선택한다.

title: Improvement of Chinese Input Method Based on Standard Keyboard
authors: Wang, Zhongjian and Liu, Honglei and Deng, Yibo and Xu, Jun
venue: 2010 Second International Workshop on Education Technology and Computer Science
summary_en: Keyboard controls navigate Chinese candidate rows and columns; a second hint area supplies contextual phrases.
summary_zh: 键盘控制用于导航汉字候选的行列，另一个提示区域提供上下文词组。
summary_ja: キーボードで中国語候補の行・列を移動し、別のヒント領域に文脈に合う句を表示する。
summary_ko: 키보드로 중국어 후보의 행과 열을 탐색하며 별도 힌트 영역에 문맥에 맞는 구를 표시한다.

title: HIT-OR3C: an opening recognition corpus for Chinese characters
authors: Zhou, Shusen and Chen, Qingcai and Wang, Xiaolong
venue: Proceedings of the 9th IAPR International Workshop on Document Analysis Systems
summary_en: A Chinese handwriting corpus records pen trajectories with segmentation, editing gestures and document checking; it does not benchmark recognition output.
summary_zh: 中文手写语料记录笔轨迹，并提供分割、编辑手势及文档核查；研究未评测识别输出。
summary_ja: 中国語手書きコーパスが筆跡、分割、編集ジェスチャー、文書確認を記録する。認識出力の性能評価ではない。
summary_ko: 중국어 필기 코퍼스가 펜 궤적·분할·편집 제스처·문서 검사를 기록한다. 인식 출력의 벤치마크는 수행하지 않는다.

title: An auxiliary unicode Han character lookup service based on glyph shape similarity
authors: Lin, Jeng-Wei and Lin, Feng-Sheng
venue: 2011 11th International Symposium on Communications & Information Technologies (ISCIT)
summary_en: A known, visually similar Han character retrieves ranked rare glyphs with Unicode details through a shape-similarity lookup service.
summary_zh: 输入一个已知且外形相近的汉字，即可通过字形相似检索服务获取排序的生僻字及 Unicode 信息。
summary_ja: 既知の似た漢字を使い、形状類似検索からUnicode情報付きの希少字形を順位付きで取り出す。
summary_ko: 알고 있는 유사한 한자를 사용하여 형태 유사도 검색으로 유니코드 정보가 포함된 희귀 글리프 순위를 얻는다.

title: User behaviors in related word retrieval and new word detection: A collaborative perspective
authors: Liu, Zhiyuan and Zheng, Yabin and Xie, Lixing and Sun, Maosong and Ru, Liyun and Zhang, Yang
venue: ACM Transactions on Asian Language Information Processing
summary_en: User–word relationships and search snippets support related-word retrieval and domain-lexicon expansion, rather than direct conversion evaluation.
summary_zh: 用户与词语关系及搜索摘要支持相关词检索和领域词库扩展，研究未直接评估输入转换。
summary_ja: 利用者と語の関係、検索抜粋により関連語検索と分野語彙の拡張を支援する。直接の変換評価ではない。
summary_ko: 사용자–단어 관계와 검색 발췌문으로 관련 단어 검색과 분야 어휘 확장을 지원하며 직접적인 변환 평가는 하지 않는다.

title: Dynamic candidate keypad for stroke-based Chinese input method on touchscreen devices
authors: Po, L. M. and Wong, C. K. and Ting, C. W. and Ng, K. H. and Wong, K. M. and Cheung, C. H. and Cheung, K. W.
venue: 2011 IEEE Symposium on Computers & Informatics
summary_en: Directional gestures select Chinese candidates around a five-stroke touchscreen keypad using first-three/last-three stroke codes.
summary_zh: 在五笔画触屏键盘周围，通过方向手势选择采用前三笔与末三笔编码的汉字候选。
summary_ja: 最初の3画・最後の3画のコードを使い、5筆画タッチキーの周囲の漢字候補を方向ジェスチャーで選ぶ。
summary_ko: 처음 세 획·마지막 세 획 코드를 사용하여 5획 터치 키 주변의 한자 후보를 방향 제스처로 선택한다.

title: Automatic chinese topic term spelling correction in online Pinyin input
authors: Sha, Sha and Jun, Liu and Qinghua, Zheng and Wei, Zhang
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Human-centric Computing 2011 and Embedded and Multimedia Computing 2011
summary_en: Entered Chinese queries are mapped back to Pinyin and matched to topic dictionaries for spelling correction and completion.
summary_zh: 将已输入的中文查询映射回拼音，再匹配主题词典，进行拼写纠正与补全。
summary_ja: 入力済みの中国語検索語を拼音へ戻し、トピック辞書と照合して綴り修正と補完を行う。
summary_ko: 입력된 중국어 검색어를 병음으로 되돌려 주제 사전과 대조하여 철자 교정과 완성을 수행한다.

title: The Chinese Input Challenges for Chinese as Second Language Learners in Computer-Mediated Writing: An Exploratory Study.
authors: Wong, L. H. and Chai, C. S. and Gao, P.
venue: … Online Journal of Educational Technology-TOJET
summary_en: Second-language learners compose Chinese using freely chosen Pinyin, handwriting and dictionary tools.
summary_zh: 汉语二语学习者自由选择拼音、手写及词典工具进行中文写作。
summary_ja: 第二言語学習者が拼音・手書き・辞書ツールを自由に選んで中国語の文を作る。
summary_ko: 제2언어 학습자가 병음·필기·사전 도구를 자유롭게 선택하여 중국어 글을 작성한다.

title: Chime: An efficient error-tolerant chinese pinyin input method
authors: Zheng, Yabin and Li, Chen and Sun, Maosong
venue: IJCAI
summary_en: CHIME repairs word-separated Pinyin chunks within a bounded edit distance before decoding Chinese text.
summary_zh: CHIME 在限定编辑距离内修正按词分隔的拼音片段，再解码为中文文本。
summary_ja: CHIMEは単語ごとに区切った拼音を一定の編集距離内で修正してから、中国語文字列に復号する。
summary_ko: CHIME은 단어별로 구분된 병음을 제한된 편집 거리 안에서 교정한 뒤 중국어 텍스트로 디코딩한다.

title: Why press backspace? understanding user input behaviors in chinese pinyin input method
authors: Zheng, Yabin and Xie, Lixing and Liu, Zhiyuan and Sun, Maosong and Zhang, Yang and Ru, Liyun
venue: Proceedings of the 49th …
summary_en: Logs of Pinyin input, committed Chinese and backspaces are analyzed to study input behavior and infer likely correction pairs.
summary_zh: 分析拼音输入、已提交汉字及退格日志，以研究输入行为并推断可能的纠错对。
summary_ja: 拼音入力、確定済み漢字、後退削除のログから入力行動を調べ、修正前後の対を推定する。
summary_ko: 병음 입력·확정 한자·백스페이스 기록을 분석하여 입력 행동을 연구하고 수정 전후 쌍을 추정한다.

title: Overlapped handwriting input on mobile phones
authors: Zou, Yanming and Liu, Yingfei and Liu, Ying and Wang, Kongqiao
venue: 2011 International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition
summary_en: Overlapping Chinese handwriting uses progressive ink fading on a phone, with final text recognized offline.
summary_zh: 手机上的重叠中文手写通过逐步淡化墨迹显示，最终文字在离线条件下识别。
summary_ja: 携帯上で重ね書きした中国語のインクを徐々に薄くし、最終文字列はオフラインで認識する。
summary_ko: 휴대폰에서 겹쳐 쓴 중국어 잉크를 점차 흐리게 표시하며 최종 텍스트는 오프라인으로 인식한다.

title: PinyinPie: a pie menu augmented soft keyboard for Chinese Pinyin input methods
authors: Liu, Ying and Chen, Xiantao and Wang, Lingzhi and Zhang, Hequan and Li, Shen
venue: Proceedings of the 14th international conference on Human-computer interaction with mobile devices and services
summary_en: A leading-letter tap opens a pie menu for Pinyin suffix gestures, feeding an existing Chinese IME.
summary_zh: 点击首字母后打开饼状菜单，通过手势选择拼音后缀，再交由现有中文输入法处理。
summary_ja: 先頭字母のタップで円形メニューを開き、後続の拼音をジェスチャーで指定して既存の中国語IMEへ送る。
summary_ko: 첫 글자를 탭하면 파이 메뉴가 열리며 후속 병음을 제스처로 지정하여 기존 중국어 IME에 전달한다.

title: Enjoying text input with image-enabled ime
authors: Masui, Toshiyuki
venue: Advances in Computer Entertainment
summary_en: Pronunciation prefixes retrieve mixed Japanese-word and image candidates; cycling and confirmation insert the selected item.
summary_zh: 读音前缀检索由日文词语及图片组成的候选，用户循环浏览并确认插入选定项。
summary_ja: 読みの接頭部から日本語単語と画像の混在候補を検索し、巡回と確定で選んだ項目を挿入する。
summary_ko: 발음 접두부로 일본어 단어와 이미지의 혼합 후보를 검색하고 순환·확정으로 선택 항목을 삽입한다.

title: A unified approach to transliteration-based text input with online spelling correction
authors: Suzuki, Hisami and Gao, Jianfeng
venue: … 2012 Joint Conference on Empirical Methods …
summary_en: Backspace-derived corrections train a joint model of Pinyin spelling repair and Chinese sequence conversion.
summary_zh: 利用退格操作提取的纠错数据，训练联合处理拼音拼写修正与中文序列转换的模型。
summary_ja: 後退削除から得た修正例で、拼音の綴り修正と漢字系列変換の統合モデルを学習する。
summary_ko: 백스페이스에서 얻은 교정 사례로 병음 철자 교정과 한자 시퀀스 변환의 결합 모델을 학습한다.

title: An approach for real-time recognition of online Chinese handwritten sentences
authors: Wang, Da-Han and Liu, Cheng-Lin and Zhou, Xiang-Dong
venue: Pattern Recognition
summary_en: Online Chinese sentence handwriting is jointly segmented and recognized, with user gestures for splitting, merging and candidate correction.
summary_zh: 在线中文句子手写联合进行分割与识别，用户可通过手势拆分、合并及修正候选。
summary_ja: オンラインの中国語文手書きを分割と認識で共同処理し、ジェスチャーで分割・結合・候補修正を行う。
summary_ko: 온라인 중국어 문장 필기를 공동 분할·인식하고 사용자 제스처로 분리·병합·후보 교정을 수행한다.

title: Improving mandarin predictive text input by augmenting pinyin initials with speech and tonal information
authors: Wang, Guangsen and Li, Bo and Liu, Shilin and Wang, Xuancong and Wang, Xiaoxuan and Sim, Khe Chai
venue: Proceedings of the 14th ACM international conference on Multimodal interaction
summary_en: Speech and typed or handwritten Pinyin initials are combined to predict Chinese text, including simulated candidate selection.
summary_zh: 结合语音与键入或手写的拼音声母预测中文文本，评估包括模拟候选选择。
summary_ja: 音声とキー入力または手書きの拼音頭文字を組み合わせて中国語を予測し、模擬候補選択も扱う。
summary_ko: 음성과 타이핑 또는 필기 병음 첫 글자를 결합하여 중국어를 예측하며 모의 후보 선택도 포함한다.

title: A machine translation approach for Chinese whole-sentence pinyin-to-character conversion
authors: Yang, Shaohua and Zhao, Hai and Lu, Bao-liang
venue: Proceedings of the 26th Pacific Asia …
summary_en: A phrase-based translation model maps aligned Pinyin syllables to Chinese sentences without word reordering.
summary_zh: 基于短语的翻译模型将对齐的拼音音节映射为中文句子，不进行词序重排。
summary_ja: 句に基づく翻訳モデルが、対応付けた拼音音節を語順変更なしで中国語文へ写像する。
summary_ko: 구 기반 번역 모델이 정렬된 병음 음절을 어순 변경 없이 중국어 문장으로 변환한다.

title: Design of a Chinese input method on the remote controller based on the embedded system
authors: Zhu, Miao-miao and Gao, Wan lin and Zhao, Zong-yuan and Jiang, Hong-biao
venue: Procedia Engineering
summary_en: An embedded remote-control IME maps numeric keys to Pinyin and Chinese candidates, with paging and frequency adaptation.
summary_zh: 嵌入式遥控输入法将数字键映射至拼音和汉字候选，并支持翻页及词频自适应。
summary_ja: 組込みリモコンIMEで数字キーを拼音と漢字候補に対応させ、ページ切替と頻度適応を行う。
summary_ko: 임베디드 리모컨 IME가 숫자 키를 병음과 한자 후보에 대응시키며 페이지 전환과 빈도 적응을 지원한다.

title: User experience with Chinese handwriting input on touch-screen mobile phones
authors: Gao, Qin and Zhu, Bin and Rau, Pei-Luen Patrick and Vyas, Shilpa and Chen, Cuiling and Li, Hui
venue: Cross-Cultural Design. Methods, Practice, and Case Studies
summary_en: Mobile handwriting input is studied in contacts and messaging tasks containing Chinese, English, numbers and punctuation.
summary_zh: 在包含中文、英文、数字及标点的通讯录与短信任务中研究手机手写输入。
summary_ja: 連絡先とメッセージの課題で、中国語・英語・数字・句読点が混在する携帯手書き入力を調べる。
summary_ko: 연락처와 메시지 과제로 중국어·영어·숫자·문장 부호가 섞인 모바일 필기 입력을 연구한다.

title: Kyss 1.0: a framework for automatic evaluation of Chinese input method engines
authors: Jia, Zhongye and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of the sixth international joint …
summary_en: KySS evaluates the candidate-selection and paging effort of Chinese IMEs, excluding the fixed cost of typing Pinyin.
summary_zh: KySS 评估中文输入法的候选选择及翻页成本，不计入固定的拼音键入成本。
summary_ja: KySSは拼音入力の固定コストを除き、中国語IMEの候補選択とページ切替の負担を評価する。
summary_ko: KySS는 병음 타이핑의 고정 비용을 제외하고 중국어 IME의 후보 선택과 페이지 전환 부담을 평가한다.

title: Using Mutual Information Criterion to Design an Effective Lexicon for Chinese Pinyin-to-Character Conversion
authors: Li, Wei and Zhang, Jinsong and Xie, Yanlu and Wang, Xiaoyun and Nishida, Masafumi and Yamamoto, Seiichi
venue: 2013 International Conference on Asian Language Processing
summary_en: Mutual information selects lexicon units for Pinyin-to-Chinese decoding, including useful collocations beyond conventional words.
summary_zh: 互信息用于选择拼音转汉字的词库单元，其中包括传统词语之外的有效搭配。
summary_ja: 相互情報量で拼音漢字復号の語彙単位を選び、通常の単語以外の有用な連語も含める。
summary_ko: 상호 정보량으로 병음–한자 디코딩의 어휘 단위를 선택하며 일반 단어 외의 유용한 연어도 포함한다.

title: Investigating the factors of practice time and literacy on children's Chinese typing skills
authors: LIU, Ellen and LIAO, Calvin and Chana, Tak-Wai
venue: International Conference on Computers in Education
summary_en: Children practice traditional Chinese entry through Zhuyin; the study examines practice time and literacy in typing performance.
summary_zh: 儿童通过注音练习繁体中文输入，研究考察练习时间及识字能力与打字表现的关系。
summary_ja: 子どもが注音で繁体字入力を練習し、練習時間と読み書き能力が入力成績にどう関係するかを調べる。
summary_ko: 아동이 주음으로 번체 한자 입력을 연습하며 연습 시간과 문해력이 입력 성과에 미치는 관계를 조사한다.

title: METODA VNOSA» PET POTEZ «: PREDNOSTI IN TEŽAVE
authors: Petrovčič, M.
venue: Acta Linguistica Asiatica
summary_en: Five-stroke numeric input uses the first four and final strokes, comparing Chinese and Japanese forms and regional stroke orders.
summary_zh: 五笔画数字输入采用前四笔与末笔，研究比较中文与日文字形及地区笔顺差异。
summary_ja: 5種の筆画による数字入力で最初の4画と最終画を使い、中国・日本の字体と地域別筆順を比較する。
summary_ko: 5종 획 기반 숫자 입력에 처음 네 획과 마지막 획을 사용하며 중국·일본 글자 형태와 지역별 획순을 비교한다.

title: Radical-stroke-based Chinese input method using dynamic radical keypad on touchscreen smartphones
authors: Po, L.
venue: Hkie Transactions Hong Kong Institution of Engineers
summary_en: A dynamic touchscreen keypad selects a radical and remaining strokes, then uses directional swipes to choose traditional Chinese candidates.
summary_zh: 动态触屏键盘选择部首及剩余笔画，再通过方向滑动选择繁体汉字候选。
summary_ja: 動的タッチキーで部首と残りの筆画を選び、方向スワイプで繁体字候補を選択する。
summary_ko: 동적 터치 키패드에서 부수와 나머지 획을 고른 뒤 방향 스와이프로 번체 한자 후보를 선택한다.

title: China's language input system in the digital age affects children's reading development
authors: Tan, Li Hai and Xu, Min and Chang, Chun Qi and Siok, Wai Ting
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
summary_en: Children's reading is related to self-reported Pinyin and handwriting exposure; the study does not assign an input-method intervention.
summary_zh: 研究考察儿童阅读与自报拼音、手写接触情况的关系，未安排输入法干预。
summary_ja: 子どもの読解と自己申告による拼音・手書き経験の関係を調べる。入力方式の介入を割り当てる研究ではない。
summary_ko: 아동의 읽기와 자기보고 병음·필기 경험의 관계를 조사하며 입력 방식 중재를 배정한 연구는 아니다.

title: Optimal entry size of handwritten Chinese characters in touch-based mobile phones
authors: Tu, H. and Ren, X.
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction
summary_en: Chinese handwriting is tested across input sizes; unsuccessful recognition requires rewriting until the correct character is obtained.
summary_zh: 在不同输入尺寸下测试中文手写，识别失败后需重新书写，直至获得正确汉字。
summary_ja: 入力サイズを変えて中国語手書きを試す。認識失敗時は正しい文字が得られるまで書き直す。
summary_ko: 입력 크기를 바꾸어 중국어 필기를 시험하며 인식에 실패하면 올바른 글자가 나올 때까지 다시 쓴다.

title: A joint graph model for pinyin-to-chinese conversion with typo correction
authors: Jia, Zhongye and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of the 52nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
summary_en: A joint graph combines Pinyin segmentation, typo alternatives and Chinese word probabilities to produce ranked conversion candidates.
summary_zh: 联合图结合拼音分割、错拼替代项和中文词概率，生成排序的转换候选。
summary_ja: 統合グラフが拼音分割、誤入力の代替、漢字単語確率を組み合わせ、順位付き変換候補を生成する。
summary_ko: 결합 그래프가 병음 분할·오타 대안·한자 단어 확률을 통합하여 순위가 매겨진 변환 후보를 생성한다.

title: Stroke++: A new Chinese input method for touch screen mobile phones
authors: Niu, Jianwei and Liu, Yang and Lin, Jialiu and Zhu, Like and Wang, Kongqiao
venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Studies
summary_en: Stroke++ combines radicals and strokes with unordered matching, ranked phrases and phrase-boundary controls on a touchscreen.
summary_zh: Stroke++ 在触屏上结合部首、笔画、无序匹配、排序词组及词组边界控制。
summary_ja: Stroke++はタッチ面で部首と筆画を組み合わせ、順序なし照合、順位付き句、句境界操作を備える。
summary_ko: Stroke++는 터치면에서 부수와 획을 결합하며 순서 없는 매칭, 순위별 구, 구 경계 제어를 지원한다.

title: A multimodal stroke-based predictive input for efficient Chinese text entry on mobile devices
authors: Sim, Khe Chai
venue: 2014 IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT)
summary_en: Initial handwritten strokes, a spatial layout and optional speech jointly predict Chinese characters and words.
summary_zh: 初始手写笔画、空间布局及可选语音共同预测汉字和词语。
summary_ja: 書き始めの筆画、空間配置、任意の音声を併用して漢字と中国語単語を予測する。
summary_ko: 초기 필기 획, 공간 배열, 선택적 음성을 함께 사용하여 한자와 중국어 단어를 예측한다.

title: A Chinese predictive text entry method for mobile devices
authors: Yang, H. L. and Lin, R. X.
venue: 2014 International Conference on Machine Learning and Cybernetics
summary_en: Previously entered Chinese strings are stored and recombined at shared characters to offer completion paths.
summary_zh: 存储已有中文输入，并在共同字符处重新组合，以提供补全路径。
summary_ja: 既入力の中国語文字列を保存し、共通文字でつなぎ替えて補完経路を提案する。
summary_ko: 이미 입력된 중국어 문자열을 저장하고 공통 글자에서 재결합하여 완성 경로를 제안한다.

title: Smart toneless pinyin input method for hakka based on natural language processing
authors: 余明興 and 黃豐隆 and 魏俊瑋 and 林昕緯
venue: Proceedings of the 27th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing Rocling 2015
summary_en: Toneless Hakka romanization converts to traditional Han text, with prediction, a custom dictionary and spoken output feedback.
summary_zh: 无调客语罗马拼音转换为繁体汉字，并提供预测、自定义词典及语音输出反馈。
summary_ja: 声調なしの客家語ローマ字を繁体字へ変換し、予測・個人辞書・音声フィードバックを備える。
summary_ko: 무성조 하카어 로마자를 번체 한자로 변환하며 예측·사용자 사전·음성 피드백을 지원한다.

title: Neural network language model for Chinese pinyin input method engine
authors: Chen, Shen-Yuan and Wang, Rui and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of the 29th Pacific Asia …
summary_en: An offline neural model revises n-gram probabilities; runtime Chinese conversion still uses a backoff language model and Viterbi decoding.
summary_zh: 离线神经模型修订 N 元概率，运行时的中文转换仍采用回退语言模型与 Viterbi 解码。
summary_ja: オフラインのニューラルモデルでN-gram確率を修正する。実行時の漢字変換はバックオフ言語モデルとViterbi復号を用いる。
summary_ko: 오프라인 신경 모델로 N-gram 확률을 수정하며 실행 중 한자 변환에는 백오프 언어 모델과 Viterbi 디코딩을 사용한다.

title: A New Input Method for Human Translators: Integrating Machine Translation Effectively and Imperceptibly.
authors: Huang, Guoping and Zhang, Jiajun and Zhou, Yu and Zong, Chengqing
venue: IJCAI
summary_en: Machine-translation hypotheses support Pinyin decoding and next-phrase suggestions while a human translator writes Chinese.
summary_zh: 在人类译者输入中文时，机器翻译假设辅助拼音解码及后续短语建议。
summary_ja: 人間の翻訳者が中国語を書く際に、機械翻訳の仮説で拼音復号と次の句の提案を支援する。
summary_ko: 사람 번역가가 중국어를 작성할 때 기계 번역 가설로 병음 디코딩과 다음 구 제안을 지원한다.

title: Investigation of Chinese text entry performance for mobile display interfaces
authors: Lin, Po-Hung
venue: Ergonomics
summary_en: Traditional Chinese Zhuyin entry is compared across physical, touchscreen and combined mobile interfaces.
summary_zh: 比较实体键盘、触屏及组合式手机界面上的繁体中文注音输入。
summary_ja: 物理キー・タッチ面・両者の組合せによる携帯画面で、繁体字の注音入力を比較する。
summary_ko: 물리 키·터치스크린·결합 모바일 인터페이스에서 번체 한자 주음 입력을 비교한다.

title: Leveraging user's performance in reporting patient safety events by utilizing text prediction in narrative data entry
authors: Gong, Yang and Hua, Lei and Wang, Shen
venue: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine
summary_en: Case-specific dictionaries and Pinyin retrieval suggest Chinese clinical phrases during patient-safety narrative entry.
summary_zh: 通过病例专用词典与拼音检索，在患者安全事件叙述输入中推荐中文临床短语。
summary_ja: 患者安全の叙述入力中に、事例別辞書と拼音検索から中国語の臨床表現を提案する。
summary_ko: 환자 안전 서술 입력 중 사례별 사전과 병음 검색으로 중국어 임상 표현을 제안한다.

title: Study on design principle of touch screen with an example of Chinese-Pinyin 10 key input method in iPhone
authors: Wu, Xiaoli and Xi, Tianyang
venue: Advances in Ergonomics in Design
summary_en: The study examines layout, color, key states and dimensions of a ten-key Pinyin touchscreen interface.
summary_zh: 研究考察十键拼音触屏界面的布局、颜色、按键状态及尺寸。
summary_ja: 10キーの拼音タッチ画面について、配置・色・キー状態・寸法を調べる。
summary_ko: 10키 병음 터치 인터페이스의 배열·색·키 상태·치수를 연구한다.

title: Pinyin-Senses Input Method for Semantic Document Exchange in E-Business
authors: Xiao, Guangyi and Guo, Jingzhi and Gong, Zhiguo and Li, Renfa
venue: 2016 IEEE 13th International Conference on e-Business Engineering (ICEBE)
summary_en: Pinyin conversion outputs both a Chinese word and a unique sense identifier; the editor can display its definition.
summary_zh: 拼音转换同时输出中文词语及唯一词义标识符，编辑器可显示相应释义。
summary_ja: 拼音変換が中国語単語と一意の語義IDを同時に出力し、エディターで定義を表示できる。
summary_ko: 병음 변환이 중국어 단어와 고유 의미 ID를 함께 출력하며 편집기에서 정의를 표시할 수 있다.

title: Word-processor or pencil-and-paper? A comparison of students' writing in Chinese as a foreign language
authors: Zhu, Yu and Mark Shum, Shiu-Kee and Brian Tse, Shek-Kam and Liu, Jinghui Jack
venue: Computer Assisted Language Learning
summary_en: Learners write Chinese essays using Pinyin in a word processor or pencil and paper; the study evaluates composition rather than recognition.
summary_zh: 学习者通过文字处理器中的拼音输入或纸笔撰写中文作文，研究评估写作而非识别。
summary_ja: 学習者が拼音ワープロまたは紙と鉛筆で中国語作文を行う。評価対象は認識ではなく作文である。
summary_ko: 학습자가 병음 워드프로세서나 종이와 연필로 중국어 작문을 하며 인식 대신 작문을 평가한다.

title: The effect of pinyin input experience on the link between semantic and phonology of Chinese character in digital writing
authors: Chen, Jingjun and Luo, Rong and Liu, Huashan
venue: Journal of Psycholinguistic Research
summary_en: Recognition judgments examine links between Chinese semantics, phonology and Pinyin experience; no text-entry task is performed.
summary_zh: 通过识别判断考察汉字语义、语音与拼音经验的联系，研究未执行文字输入任务。
summary_ja: 認識判断課題で中国語の意味・音韻・拼音経験の関係を調べる。文字入力課題は行わない。
summary_ko: 인식 판단 과제로 중국어 의미·음운·병음 경험의 관계를 조사하며 텍스트 입력 과제는 수행하지 않는다.

title: The role of size of input box, location of input box, input method and display size in Chinese handwriting performance and preference on mobile devices
authors: Chen, Zhe and Rau, Pei-Luen Patrick
venue: Applied Ergonomics
summary_en: Finger, thumb and stylus input are compared for isolated Chinese handwriting across box positions and display sizes.
summary_zh: 比较不同输入框位置及显示尺寸下的手指、拇指和触笔汉字单字手写。
summary_ja: 入力枠位置と画面サイズを変え、中国語単字手書きの指・親指・スタイラス入力を比較する。
summary_ko: 입력 상자 위치와 화면 크기를 바꾸며 중국어 단일 문자 필기의 손가락·엄지·스타일러스 입력을 비교한다.

title: Research on the input method of Hakka language for intelligent mobile devices
authors: Huang, Feng-Long and Liou, Kuei-Sen
venue: 2017 International Conference on Machine Learning and Cybernetics (ICMLC)
summary_en: Hakka romanization is converted into traditional Han text on mobile devices; speech synthesis supplies output feedback.
summary_zh: 在移动设备上将客语罗马拼音转换为繁体汉字，语音合成提供输出反馈。
summary_ja: 携帯端末で客家語ローマ字を繁体字へ変換し、音声合成で出力のフィードバックを行う。
summary_ko: 모바일 기기에서 하카어 로마자를 번체 한자로 변환하며 음성 합성으로 출력 피드백을 제공한다.

title: Research and implementation of sixian hakka pinyin input method for mobile cell app
authors: Huang, Feng-Long and Liu, Kuei-Sen and Tseng, Sheng-Yi
venue: Proceedings of the 29th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing Rocling 2017
summary_en: A Sixian Hakka mobile IME combines toneless conversion, next-word prediction, personal preferences and spoken feedback.
summary_zh: 四县客语手机输入法结合无调转换、后续词预测、个人偏好及语音反馈。
summary_ja: 四県客家語の携帯IMEが声調なし変換、次語予測、個人設定、音声フィードバックを組み合わせる。
summary_ko: 쓰셴 하카어 모바일 IME가 무성조 변환·다음 단어 예측·개인 설정·음성 피드백을 결합한다.

title: Chinese Pinyin aided IME, input what you have not keystroked yet
authors: Huang, Yafang and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of the 2018 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary_en: A neural Pinyin-to-Chinese model uses context to complete text beyond the characters directly represented by the typed prefix.
summary_zh: 神经拼音转汉字模型利用上下文，在已输入前缀直接对应的字符之外补全文本。
summary_ja: ニューラル拼音漢字モデルが文脈を使い、入力接頭部で直接指定される文字より先まで補完する。
summary_ko: 신경 병음–한자 모델이 문맥으로 입력 접두부가 직접 나타내는 글자 이후의 텍스트까지 완성한다.

title: Moon IME: neural-based chinese pinyin aided input method with customizable association
authors: Huang, Yafang and Li, Zuchao and Zhang, Zhuosheng and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of ACL 2018, System Demonstrations
summary_en: Moon IME combines neural Pinyin conversion with customizable associations, follow-up prediction and Chinese-to-English assistance.
summary_zh: Moon IME 结合神经拼音转换、自定义关联、后续预测及中译英辅助。
summary_ja: Moon IMEがニューラル拼音変換、設定可能な連想、後続予測、中国語から英語への支援を組み合わせる。
summary_ko: Moon IME가 신경 병음 변환·설정 가능한 연상·후속 예측·중국어–영어 지원을 결합한다.

title: Research and implementation of Hakka pinyin input method for mobile cell - An example of Taiwan HioLiukAccent
authors: Huang, F. L.
venue: Proceedings of the 30th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing Rocling 2018
summary_en: Hakka romanization or Mandarin Zhuyin produces Hakka text; unavailable glyphs are represented by Pinyin, with spoken feedback.
summary_zh: 客语罗马拼音或国语注音生成客语文字，无法显示的字形以拼音表示，并提供语音反馈。
summary_ja: 客家語ローマ字または標準中国語の注音から客家語文を作る。使えない字形は拼音で表し、音声で確認する。
summary_ko: 하카어 로마자나 표준 중국어 주음으로 하카어 텍스트를 만든다. 사용할 수 없는 글리프는 병음으로 표시하며 음성 피드백을 제공한다.

title: A Knowledge Based Method for Pinyin Typo Correction
authors: Ji, Xingguang and Huang, Xiaojun
venue: 2018 IEEE 9th International Conference on Software Engineering and Service Science (ICSESS)
summary_en: Knowledge-based correction handles mistyped or abbreviated Pinyin to recover intended Chinese character sequences.
summary_zh: 基于知识的纠错处理误输入或缩略拼音，以恢复目标汉字序列。
summary_ja: 知識に基づく修正で誤入力や省略された拼音を扱い、意図された漢字列を復元する。
summary_ko: 지식 기반 교정으로 오타나 축약 병음을 처리하여 의도한 한자열을 복원한다.

title: A Smart Sliding Chinese Pinyin Input Method Editor for Touchscreen Devices
authors: Meng, Zhen and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of the 2018 International Conference on Algorithms, Computing and Artificial Intelligence
summary_en: Sliding traces on an iOS keyboard are sent to a server for Pinyin interpretation and Chinese conversion.
summary_zh: 将 iOS 键盘上的滑动轨迹发送至服务器，进行拼音解释与中文转换。
summary_ja: iOSキーボード上のスライド軌跡をサーバーへ送り、拼音の解釈と漢字変換を行う。
summary_ko: iOS 키보드의 슬라이딩 궤적을 서버로 보내 병음을 해석하고 한자로 변환한다.

title: Comparing speech and keyboard text entry for short messages in two languages on touchscreen phones
authors: Ruan, Sherry and Wobbrock, Jacob O. and Liou, Kenny and Ng, Andrew and Landay, James A.
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies
summary_en: Speech and keyboard entry are compared for short English and Mandarin messages, with keyboard repair available after speech recognition.
summary_zh: 比较英文及普通话短消息的语音和键盘输入，语音识别后可通过键盘修正。
summary_ja: 英語と標準中国語の短文で音声入力とキー入力を比較し、音声認識後にキーボードで修正できる。
summary_ko: 영어와 표준 중국어의 짧은 메시지에서 음성과 키보드 입력을 비교하며 음성 인식 후 키보드 교정을 허용한다.

title: Using IM-Visor to stop untrusted IME apps from stealing sensitive keystrokes
authors: Tian, C.
venue: Cybersecurity
summary_en: IM-Visor shields sensitive keystrokes from third-party Android IMEs. Its evaluated tasks concern Latin input rather than Han conversion.
summary_zh: IM-Visor 防止第三方 Android 输入法获取敏感按键，评估任务涉及拉丁文字输入，而非汉字转换。
summary_ja: IM-VisorはAndroidの第三者IMEから機密キー入力を保護する。評価課題はラテン文字入力であり漢字変換ではない。
summary_ko: IM-Visor는 Android의 제3자 IME로부터 민감한 키 입력을 보호한다. 평가 과제는 라틴 문자 입력이며 한자 변환이 아니다.

title: TestIME: A Tool for Testing Chinese Input Method Engines in Electronic Medical Record Entry Task
authors: Yang, Feihong and Li, Jiao
venue: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI)
summary_en: TestIME compares Chinese input engines during exact transcription of electronic medical records, requiring correction of character differences.
summary_zh: TestIME 在电子病历逐字抄录中比较中文输入引擎，要求修正字符差异。
summary_ja: TestIMEが電子診療記録の正確な転記で中国語入力エンジンを比較し、文字の相違の修正を求める。
summary_ko: TestIME이 전자의무기록의 정확한 전사로 중국어 입력 엔진을 비교하며 문자 차이의 교정을 요구한다.

title: Enabling real-time neural IME with incremental vocabulary selection
authors: Yao, Jiali and Shu, Raphael and Li, Xinjian and Ohtsuki, Katsutoshi and Nakayama, Hideki
venue: Naacl Hlt 2019 2019 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics Human Language Technologies Proceedings of the Conference
summary_en: An incremental vocabulary reduces neural decoding cost as Romaji-derived kana is converted into Japanese word-lattice candidates.
summary_zh: 将罗马字生成的假名转换为日文词格候选时，通过增量词表降低神经解码开销。
summary_ja: 逐次的な語彙制限でニューラル復号のコストを減らし、ローマ字由来の仮名を日本語の語格子候補へ変換する。
summary_ko: 점진적 어휘 제한으로 신경 디코딩 비용을 줄이며 로마자에서 나온 가나를 일본어 단어 격자 후보로 변환한다.

title: SeeIME: a Chinese mobile IME for Chinese learners based on hybrid Pinyin code
authors: Yao, Jian and Shen, Xingfa and Qiu, Jianhui and Wang, Ting
venue: Proceedings of the ACM Turing Celebration Conference - China
summary_en: A learner-oriented mobile IME displays Pinyin, Chinese characters and English together using a hybrid Pinyin code.
summary_zh: 面向学习者的手机输入法采用混合拼音编码，同时显示拼音、汉字及英文。
summary_ja: 学習者向け携帯IMEが混合拼音コードを使い、拼音・漢字・英語を一緒に表示する。
summary_ko: 학습자용 모바일 IME가 혼합 병음 코드를 사용하여 병음·한자·영어를 함께 표시한다.

title: Open vocabulary learning for neural Chinese pinyin IME
authors: Zhang, Zhuosheng and Huang, Yafang and Zhao, Hai
venue: Proceedings of the 57th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
summary_en: An open-vocabulary neural IME learns new Chinese words during simulated Pinyin conversion on news and historical chat data.
summary_zh: 开放词表神经输入法在新闻及历史聊天数据的模拟拼音转换中学习新词。
summary_ja: 開語彙ニューラルIMEがニュースと過去のチャットを使う模擬拼音変換中に、新しい中国語単語を学習する。
summary_ko: 개방 어휘 신경 IME가 뉴스와 과거 채팅 자료의 모의 병음 변환 중 새로운 중국어 단어를 학습한다.

title: SmartHandwriting: Handwritten Chinese character recognition with smartwatch
authors: Zhang, Jian and Bi, Hongliang and Chen, Yanjiao and Wang, Mingyu and Han, Liming and Cai, Ligan
venue: IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary_en: A smartwatch senses acceleration and rotation while the user writes Chinese characters on paper, producing recognition labels.
summary_zh: 用户在纸上书写汉字时，智能手表感知加速度与转动，并产生识别标签。
summary_ja: 紙に漢字を書く際の加速度と回転を腕時計で測り、認識ラベルを生成する。
summary_ko: 종이에 한자를 쓰는 동안 스마트워치로 가속도와 회전을 감지하여 인식 라벨을 생성한다.

title: Evaluation of intelligent speech technology in epidemic prevention: Take iflytek input software in Chinese and Japanese recognition as an example
authors: Cao, Chen and Wang, Gaowu
venue: Journal of Physics: Conference Series
summary_en: Chinese and Japanese simulated medical dialogues are dictated into an IME and transcribed into a memo application.
summary_zh: 将模拟中文及日文医患对话口述至输入法，再转写到备忘录应用。
summary_ja: 中国語と日本語の模擬診療会話をIMEへ口述し、メモアプリに転記する。
summary_ko: 중국어와 일본어의 모의 진료 대화를 IME에 구술하여 메모 앱에 전사한다.

title: Design and development of an EOG-based simplified Chinese eye-writing system
authors: Ding, XiaoJuan and Lv, Zhao
venue: Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary_en: Eye-writing signals are used to enter a small set of simplified Chinese characters, with calibration and confirm/cancel operations.
summary_zh: 眼写信号用于输入少量简体汉字，系统提供校准及确认、取消操作。
summary_ja: 眼書き信号から少数の簡体字を入力し、校正と確定・取り消し操作を備える。
summary_ko: 눈으로 쓰는 신호로 소수의 간체 한자를 입력하며 보정과 확인·취소를 지원한다.

title: The influence of smartphone text input method, posture, and environment on user experience
authors: Li, Ying and You, Fangzhou and Ji, Ming and You, Xuqun
venue: International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction
summary_en: Phone posture, environment and tapping layout are compared during mixed Chinese and English short-message entry with corrections allowed.
summary_zh: 在允许纠错的中英文混合短消息输入中，比较手机姿势、环境及点击键盘布局。
summary_ja: 修正可能な中英混在短文の入力で、携帯の持ち方・環境・タップ配列を比較する。
summary_ko: 교정을 허용한 중국어·영어 혼합 짧은 메시지 입력에서 휴대폰 자세·환경·탭 배열을 비교한다.

title: Stroke sequence-dependent deep convolutional neural network for online handwritten Chinese character recognition
authors: Liu, Xin and Hu, Baotian and Chen, Qingcai and Wu, Xiangping and You, Jinghan
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary_en: A stroke-sequence-dependent neural network classifies isolated handwritten Chinese characters; no live candidate or repair interface is tested.
summary_zh: 依赖笔画序列的神经网络分类独立手写汉字，未测试实时候选或修正界面。
summary_ja: 筆順依存のニューラルネットワークで手書き単字を分類する。実時間の候補や修正画面は試さない。
summary_ko: 획 순서 의존 신경망으로 고립된 필기 한자를 분류하며 실시간 후보나 교정 인터페이스는 시험하지 않는다.

title: A Subsequent Words Recommendation Scheme for Chinese Input Method based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yang, Jingyun and Wang, Hengjun and Guo, Kexiang
venue: 2020 IEEE 6th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
summary_en: Deep reinforcement learning recommends words after an entered Chinese context, without evaluating a specific Pinyin or shape-code interface.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习根据已输入的中文上下文推荐后续词，未评估特定拼音或形码界面。
summary_ja: 入力済みの中国語文脈から深層強化学習で語を推薦する。特定の拼音・形状コード画面は評価しない。
summary_ko: 입력된 중국어 문맥 뒤에 심층 강화학습으로 단어를 추천하며 특정 병음·형태 코드 인터페이스는 평가하지 않는다.

title: User preference toward appearance of mobile input method editor based on Kansei engineering
authors: Zhang, Yun and Cao, Yaqin and Ding, Yi and Zhao, Yujie
venue: Digital Human Modeling and Applications in Health, Safety, Ergonomics and Risk Management. Human Communication, Organization and Work
summary_en: Users rate the appearance of mobile IME skins; the study evaluates visual preference rather than text-entry performance.
summary_zh: 用户评价手机输入法皮肤的外观，研究评估视觉偏好，而非文字输入表现。
summary_ja: 携帯IMEのスキンの外観を利用者が評価する。文字入力性能ではなく視覚的な好みを扱う。
summary_ko: 사용자가 모바일 IME 스킨의 외관을 평가하며 문자 입력 성능 대신 시각적 선호를 다룬다.

title: Children's neurodevelopment of reading is affected by China's language input system in the information era
authors: Zhou, Wei and Kwok, Veronica P. Y. and Su, Mengmeng and Luo, Jin and Tan, Li Hai
venue: npj Science of Learning
summary_en: Reading and character-judgment tasks examine associations with children's Pinyin typing exposure; typing is not performed during scanning.
summary_zh: 通过阅读及汉字判断任务考察儿童拼音输入接触情况的关联，扫描期间未进行打字。
summary_ja: 読解と文字判断から子どもの拼音入力経験との関連を調べる。スキャン中はタイピングしない。
summary_ko: 읽기와 문자 판단 과제로 아동의 병음 입력 경험과의 관계를 조사하며 스캔 중에는 타이핑하지 않는다.

title: Adaptive Chinese pinyin IME for most similar representation
authors: Jiang, Dongsheng and Cheng, Xinyu and Han, Tianyi
venue: IEEE Access
summary_en: Representation similarity adapts Pinyin conversion across news, chat, legal and medical domains in simulated sequential domain shifts.
summary_zh: 在模拟的连续领域切换中，通过表征相似性使拼音转换适应新闻、聊天、法律和医疗领域。
summary_ja: 表現類似度によりニュース・チャット・法律・医療の拼音変換を適応させ、模擬的な分野の逐次変化で評価する。
summary_ko: 표현 유사도로 뉴스·채팅·법률·의료의 병음 변환을 적응시키고 모의 순차적 분야 전환에서 평가한다.

title: Fast and robust online handwritten Chinese character recognition with deep spatial and contextual information fusion network
authors: Li, Yunxin and Yang, Qian and Chen, Qingcai and Hu, Baotian and Wang, Xiaolong and Ding, Yuxin and Ma, Lin
venue: IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary_en: Spatial and contextual neural features recognize Chinese characters in constructed handwriting sequences derived from existing datasets.
summary_zh: 通过空间及上下文神经特征，识别由既有数据集构建的手写序列中的汉字。
summary_ja: 既存データセットから構成した手書き列で、空間・文脈のニューラル特徴を用いて漢字を認識する。
summary_ko: 기존 데이터셋으로 구성한 필기 시퀀스에서 공간·문맥 신경 특징을 사용하여 한자를 인식한다.

title: Exploring and adapting Chinese GPT to pinyin input method
authors: Tan, M. and Dai, Y. and Tang, D. and Feng, Z. and Huang, G. and others
venue: Proceedings of the …
summary_en: PinyinGPT adapts Chinese generation to complete or abbreviated Pinyin with context; mixed forms and typo repair are not implemented.
summary_zh: PinyinGPT 使中文生成适应带上下文的全拼或缩写拼音，未实现混合形式及错拼修复。
summary_ja: PinyinGPTが文脈付きの全拼音または省略拼音へ中国語生成を適応させる。混合形式と誤入力修正は未実装である。
summary_ko: PinyinGPT가 문맥이 있는 전체 또는 축약 병음에 중국어 생성을 적응시킨다. 혼합 형태와 오타 교정은 구현되지 않았다.

title: Pinyin-to-Chinese conversion on sentence-level for domain-specific applications using self-attention model
authors: Xiong, Shufeng and Ma, Li and Cheng, Ming and Wang, Bingkun
venue: Multimedia Systems
summary_en: Self-attention converts sentence-level Pinyin to Chinese in news and medical domains, evaluated with idealized character edits.
summary_zh: 自注意力将新闻及医疗领域的句级拼音转换为中文，并使用理想化字符编辑条件评估。
summary_ja: 自己注意で文単位の拼音をニュース・医療分野の中国語へ変換し、理想化した文字編集で評価する。
summary_ko: 자기 주의로 문장 단위 병음을 뉴스·의료 분야 중국어로 변환하며 이상화된 문자 편집으로 평가한다.

title: Using less keystrokes to achieve high top-1 accuracy in Chinese clinical text entry
authors: Li, Tao and Yu, Lei and Zhou, Liang and Wang, Panzhang
venue: DIGITAL HEALTH
summary_en: A clinical suggestion tool offers Chinese medical text alongside the existing IME, with separate keys for accepting each source's candidates.
summary_zh: 临床建议工具在既有输入法旁提供中文医疗文本，并用不同按键接受各来源的候选。
summary_ja: 臨床提案ツールが既存IMEと並んで中国語医療文を提案し、それぞれの候補を別のキーで受け入れる。
summary_ko: 임상 제안 도구가 기존 IME와 함께 중국어 의료 텍스트를 제안하며 각 출처의 후보를 서로 다른 키로 수락한다.

title: Internet use predicts Chinese character spelling performance of junior high school students: multiple mediating roles of pinyin input proficiency and net-speak …
authors: Luo, Rong and Peng, Yifan and Chen, Jingjun
venue: Frontiers in Psychology
summary_en: Survey measures of internet use and Pinyin proficiency are related to Chinese spelling tests, rather than measured typing speed.
summary_zh: 将互联网使用及拼音熟练度的问卷指标与汉字拼写测试联系起来，未实测打字速度。
summary_ja: インターネット利用と拼音習熟の質問紙指標を中国語の綴り課題と関連付ける。実測入力速度は扱わない。
summary_ko: 인터넷 사용과 병음 숙련도 설문 지표를 중국어 철자 검사와 연결하며 실제 타이핑 속도는 측정하지 않는다.

title: Generative input: towards next-generation input methods paradigm
authors: Ding, Keyu and Wang, Yongcan and Xu, Zihang and Jia, Zhenzhen and Chen, Enhong
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics ACL 2024
summary_en: GeneInput unifies full, abbreviated and mistyped Pinyin conversion with continuation and rewriting in a generative input framework.
summary_zh: GeneInput 在生成式输入框架中统一全拼、缩写和错拼转换，并支持续写及改写。
summary_ja: GeneInputが全拼音・省略・誤入力の変換と文章継続・書換えを生成型入力の枠組みに統合する。
summary_ko: GeneInput이 전체·축약·오타 병음 변환과 이어 쓰기·재작성을 생성형 입력 체계에 통합한다.

title: CN-T9: Optimization of T9 Chinese Input Layout
authors: Guo, Yikai and He, Jixiao and Bai, Rongtian and Wu, Zhengyang and Huang, Yuhang
venue: 26th International Conference on Mobile Human-Computer Interaction
summary_en: CN-T9 rearranges a numeric Pinyin keyboard to improve Chinese input layout; product implementation is discussed as future work.
summary_zh: CN-T9 重排数字拼音键盘以改进中文输入布局，产品实现属于后续工作。
summary_ja: CN-T9が数字拼音キーボードを再配置して中国語入力の配列を改善する。製品実装は今後の課題である。
summary_ko: CN-T9가 숫자 병음 키보드를 재배열하여 중국어 입력 배열을 개선한다. 제품 구현은 향후 과제로 논의한다.

title: The Not-So-Silent Type: Vulnerabilities in Chinese IME Keyboards’ Network Security Protocols
authors: Knockel, Jeffrey and Wang, Mona and Reichert, Zoë
venue: Proceedings of the 2024 on ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security
summary_en: Network-security testing examines cloud Pinyin traffic in Chinese IMEs, rather than conversion accuracy or typing speed.
summary_zh: 网络安全测试考察中文输入法的云拼音通信，而非转换准确率或输入速度。
summary_ja: ネットワークセキュリティ検査で中国語IMEのクラウド拼音通信を調べる。変換精度や入力速度の評価ではない。
summary_ko: 네트워크 보안 시험으로 중국어 IME의 클라우드 병음 트래픽을 조사하며 변환 정확도나 타이핑 속도를 평가하지 않는다.

title: Exploring Conditional Variational Mechanism to Pinyin Input Method for Addressing One-to-Many Mappings in Low-Resource Scenarios
authors: Sun, Bin and Li, Jianfeng and Zhou, Hao and Meng, Fandong and Li, Kan and Zhou, Jie
venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 2: Short Papers)
summary_en: A conditional variational Transformer models multiple Chinese outputs for ambiguous nine-key and twenty-six-key Pinyin input.
summary_zh: 条件变分 Transformer 针对九键及二十六键拼音输入的歧义，建模多个可能的中文输出。
summary_ja: 条件付き変分Transformerが、曖昧な9キー・26キー拼音入力に対する複数の中国語出力をモデル化する。
summary_ko: 조건부 변분 Transformer가 모호한 9키·26키 병음 입력에 대한 여러 중국어 출력을 모델링한다.

title: Investigating context-aware collaborative text entry on smartphones using large language models
authors: Chen, Weihao and Shi, Yuanchun and Wang, Yukun and Shi, Weinan and Chen, Meizhu and Gao, Cheng and Mei, Yu and Zhu, Yeshuang and Zhang, Jinchao and Yu, Chun
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
summary_en: CATIA uses recent screen context to suggest Chinese intentions and text; users revise, regenerate and insert suggestions into their apps.
summary_zh: CATIA 利用近期屏幕上下文推荐中文意图及文本，用户可修改、重新生成并插入应用。
summary_ja: CATIAが直近の画面文脈から中国語の意図と文を提案し、利用者が修正・再生成してアプリへ挿入する。
summary_ko: CATIA가 최근 화면 문맥으로 중국어 의도와 텍스트를 제안하며 사용자가 수정·재생성하여 앱에 삽입한다.

title: Enhancing GPT-Based Input Method with Domain-Adaptive Pinyin Encoder (s)
authors: Peng, Wenyao and Shi, Xiaodong
venue: Natural Language Processing and Chinese Computing
summary_en: Pinyin encoders condition GPT-based Chinese conversion on correctly segmented, clean Pinyin, with constrained character decoding.
summary_zh: 拼音编码器以正确分词、无错拼的拼音为条件，通过受约束字符解码辅助 GPT 中文转换。
summary_ja: 拼音エンコーダーが正しく分割された誤りのない拼音でGPT漢字変換を条件付け、文字復号を制約する。
summary_ko: 병음 인코더가 올바르게 분할된 오류 없는 병음으로 GPT 한자 변환을 조건화하며 문자 디코딩을 제약한다.

title: A tone-assisted Chinese silent speech input method for virtual reality
authors: Zhang, Xinyu and Shan, Xinyuan and Zhou, Yang and Chen, Zihong and Tan, Peng and Xing, Youlu and Bin, Luo and Pan, Zhigeng and Feng, Guihuan
venue: International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction
summary_en: Silent lip movements and touchpad tone gestures are fused in VR to generate Mandarin Han text without acoustic speech input.
summary_zh: 在 VR 中融合无声唇动与触控板声调手势，生成普通话汉字文本，无需声学语音输入。
summary_ja: VRで無音の唇運動とタッチパッドの声調ジェスチャーを融合し、音声入力なしで標準中国語の漢字列を生成する。
summary_ko: VR에서 무음 입술 움직임과 터치패드 성조 제스처를 융합하여 음향 음성 입력 없이 표준 중국어 한자 텍스트를 생성한다.
